Title: 1. Peter Pan
description: Wendy and her brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan.

Title: 2. The Robe
description: In the Roman province of Judea during the 1st century, Roman tribune Marcellus Gallio is ordered to crucify Jesus of Nazareth but is tormented by his guilty conscience afterwards.

Title: 3. House of Wax
description: An associate burns down a wax museum with the owner inside, but he survives only to become vengeful and murderous.

Title: 4. The Earrings of Madame De...
description: When an aristocratic woman known only as "Madame de . . ." sells a pair of earrings given to her by her husband in order to pay some debts, she sets off a chain reaction of financial and carnal consequences that can end only in despair.

Title: 5. I Vitelloni
description: A character study of five young men at crucial turning points in their lives in a small town in Italy.

Title: 6. From Here to Eternity
description: At a U.S. Army base in 1941 Hawaii, a pugilistic private is cruelly punished for refusing to join his unit's boxing team. Meanwhile, his commanding officer's wife and top NCO are indulging in a torrid love affair.

Title: 7. Little Fugitive
description: A young boy fears that he shot his older brother, who is only faking. He then runs away to Coney Island, a crowded beach area, and gets money by returning soda bottles for their deposits.

Title: 8. The Wages of Fear
description: In a decrepit South American village, four men are hired to transport an urgent nitroglycerine shipment without the equipment that would make it safe.

Title: 9. El
description: A husband's suave exterior unravels after his marriage, and he unleashes his paranoid and volatile temper on his wife, which escalates to more dangerous and unpredictable tantrums.

Title: 10. When You Read This Letter
description: Therese is a nun-in-training who returns to "civilian" life to care for her young sister Denise.

Title: 11. Ugetsu
description: A tale of ambition, family, love, and war set in the midst of the Japanese Civil Wars of the sixteenth century.

Title: 12. Glen or Glenda
description: A psychiatrist tells the stories of a transvestite (Glen or Glenda) and a pseudohermaphrodite (Alan or Anne).

Title: 13. Anatahan
description: From June 1944, twelve Japanese seamen are stranded for seven years on an abandoned and forgotten island called Anatahan.

Title: 14. Roman Holiday
description: A bored and sheltered princess escapes her guardians and falls in love with an American newsman in Rome.

Title: 15. Tokyo Story
description: An old couple visit their children and grandchildren in the city, but receive little attention.

Title: 16. Shane
description: An ex-gunfighter defends homesteaders in 1889 Wyoming.

Title: 17. The Big Heat
description: An unscrupulous police detective takes on a crime syndicate with powerful political ties.

Title: 18. Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
description: Showgirls Lorelei Lee and Dorothy Shaw travel to Paris, pursued by a private detective hired by the suspicious father of Lorelei's fiancé, as well as a rich, enamored old man and many other doting admirers.

Title: 19. Stalag 17
description: After two American prisoners are killed by the guards in the act of escaping from a German P.O.W. camp in World War II, the barracks black marketeer, J.J. Sefton, is suspected of being an informer.

Title: 20. Hondo
description: Army dispatch rider Hondo Lane discovers a woman and young son living in the midst of warring Apaches and becomes their protector.

Title: 21. The War of the Worlds
description: A small town in California is attacked by Martians, beginning a worldwide invasion.

Title: 22. It Came from Outer Space
description: A spaceship from another world crashes in the Arizona desert and only an amateur stargazer and a schoolteacher suspect alien influence when the local townsfolk begin to act strangely.

Title: 23. I Confess
description: A priest who comes under suspicion for murder cannot clear his name without breaking the seal of the confessional.

Title: 24. Niagara
description: As two couples are visiting Niagara Falls, tensions between one wife and her husband reach the level of murder.

Title: 25. The Band Wagon
description: An aging movie star uncertain of his future teams up with a top ballerina to headline a new Broadway musical, but the pretentiously artistic goals of its director threaten to change it beyond recognition.

Title: 26. Pickup on South Street
description: A pickpocket unwittingly lifts a message destined for enemy agents and becomes a target for a Communist spy ring.

Title: 27. How to Marry a Millionaire
description: Three women set out to find eligible millionaires to marry, but find true love in the process.

Title: 28. The Naked Spur
description: A bounty hunter trying to bring a murderer to justice is forced to accept the help of two less-than-trustworthy strangers.

Title: 29. Dangerous Crossing
description: After a beautiful bride boards an ocean liner with her new husband, he goes into hiding, and she becomes the target of a murder conspiracy.

Title: 30. Monsieur Hulot's Holiday
description: Monsieur Hulot comes to a beachside hotel for a vacation and accidentally, but good-naturedly, causes havoc.

Title: 31. The Wild One
description: Two rival motorcycle gangs terrorize a small town after one of their leaders is thrown in jail.

Title: 32. The Hitch-Hiker
description: Two friends pick up a psychopathic escaped convict who tells them that he intends to murder them when the ride is over.

Title: 33. Kiss Me Kate
description: An ex-husband and wife team star in a musical version of 'The Taming of the Shrew'; off-stage, the production is troublesome with ex-lovers' quarrels and two gangsters looking for some money owed to them.

Title: 34. Invaders from Mars
description: A young boy learns that space aliens are taking over the minds of earthlings.

Title: 35. Summer with Monika
description: A pair of teenagers meet one summer day, start a reckless affair and abandon their families to be with one another.

Title: 36. The Bigamist
description: A man secretly married to two women feels the pressure of his deceit.

Title: 37. The Story of Three Loves
description: An anthology film consisting of three very different stories about love set in Europe and told in flashback.

Title: 38. Hiroshima
description: Brilliant and extremely realistic retelling of the day in Hiroshima that the bomb dropped and following days.

Title: 39. Lili
description: An orphaned young woman becomes part of a puppet act and forms a relationship with the anti-social puppeteer.

Title: 40. Beat the Devil
description: A seemingly innocent British couple join up with a ragtag group of swindlers in an Italian port town on their way to Africa to exploit rich uranium deposits in Kenya. Things don't go as planned.

Title: 41. Titanic
description: An unhappily married couple struggle to deal with their problems while on board the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

Title: 42. Mogambo
description: On a Kenyan safari, white hunter Victor Marswell has a love triangle with seductive American socialite Eloise Kelly and anthropologist Donald Nordley's cheating wife Linda.

Title: 43. Jeopardy
description: A family vacationing in Baja California have to cope with multiple threats to their safety as the wife desperately seeks help to prevent her trapped husband from drowning.

Title: 44. The Cruel Sea
description: The World War II adventures of a British convoy escort ship and its officers.

Title: 45. The Blue Gardenia
description: A telephone operator ends up drunk and at the mercy of a cad in his apartment. The next morning she wakes up with a hangover and the terrible fear she may have committed murder.

Title: 46. Crime Wave
description: Reformed parolee Steve Lacey is caught in the middle when a wounded former cellmate seeks him out for shelter.

Title: 47. Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: Two bumbling American cops hunt for the mysterious Mr. Hyde in London, England.

Title: 48. Stazione Termini
description: Prior to leaving by train for Paris, a married American woman tries to break off her affair with a young Italian in Rome's Stazione Termini.

Title: 49. Gate of Hell
description: A samurai pursues a married lady-in-waiting.

Title: 50. Sawdust and Tinsel
description: The complicated relationships between a circus ringmaster, his estranged wife and his lover.

Title: 51. The Magnetic Monster
description: The Office of Scientific Investigation sends A-Men agents to investigate reports of unusual magnetic activity in various communities.

Title: 52. By the Light of the Silvery Moon
description: Marjorie Winfield's engagement to Bill Sherman, who has just arrived home from fighting in World War I, serves as the backdrop for the trials and tribulations of her family.

Title: 53. Call Me Madam
description: Washington hostess Sally Adams becomes a Truman-era US ambassador to a European grand duchy.

Title: 54. Bread, Love and Dreams
description: When a veteran marshal is sent to a small town, he quickly falls for two women: a midwife and an earthy young woman nicknamed "Frisky".

Title: 55. Raiders in the Sky
description: War drama about the dangerous and stressful work of Lancaster bomber British crews during World War II.

Title: 56. Mesa of Lost Women
description: A mad scientist named Arana is creating giant spiders and dwarfs in his lab on Zarpa Mesa in Mexico. He wants to create a master race of superwomen by injecting his female subjects with spider venom.

Title: 57. I Love Lucy
description: Desi Arnaz greets the "I Love Lucy" studio audience and invites them to watch Lucille Ball and the cast film a special extended episode.

Title: 58. The Long Memory
description: Released from prison after twelve years, a wrongfully convicted British man seeks revenge on the witnesses who lied at his trial.

Title: 59. A Blueprint for Murder
description: Whitney Cameron suspects his sister-in-law has poisoned his brother and niece, but without proof how does he prevent the murder of his nephew?

Title: 60. The Brute
description: A tough young man who helps to evict poor people from their houses falls in love with a girl who lives with her father in a building that's about to be demolished.

Title: 61. I, the Jury
description: Dectective Mike Hammer is determined to catch and kill the person who shot his close friend dead, so he follows clues that lead to a beautiful, seductive woman.

Title: 62. The Black Vampire
description: The mothers of children attacked by a deranged pedophile cry out for justice.

Title: 63. Forever Female
description: An aging actress refuses to admit she is too old to play the ingénue role anymore.

Title: 64. It Happened in the Park
description: Villa Borghese, Rome's biggest urban park, is the spot where laughter and dramas take place every day.

Title: 65. Julius Caesar
description: The growing ambition of Julius Caesar is a source of major concern to his close friend Brutus. Cassius persuades him to participate in his plot to assassinate Caesar but they have both sorely underestimated Mark Antony.

Title: 66. Calamity Jane
description: The story of Calamity Jane, her saloon, and her romance with Wild Bill Hickok. The Wild West heroine helps bring a star attraction to Deadwood and finds love.

Title: 67. Vicki
description: The untimely murder of a New York glamour girl sparks an investigation with an emotionally-driven detective at the helm.

Title: 68. Fair Wind to Java
description: In 1883, an American merchant ship's captain is searching for a treasure in diamonds from a sunken Dutch ship in the vicinity of a volcanic island in the Dutch East Indies.

Title: 69. The Beast from 20,000 Fathoms
description: A ferocious dinosaur awakened by an Arctic atomic test terrorizes the North Atlantic and, ultimately, New York City.

Title: 70. Walking My Baby Back Home
description: World War II veteran Clarence "Jigger" Millard forms a band with several other former GIs. The band fails to take off and he is forced to join a minstrel show headed by Colonel Wallace. He soon falls for Wallace's niece Chris Hall.

Title: 71. China Venture
description: During WW2, an American commando team is sent to rescue the prisoner of a warlord in Japanese-occupied China.

Title: 72. The Man Behind the Gun
description: An undercover government agent battles insurrectionists who want Southern California to secede and become a slave state.

Title: 73. The Tall Texan
description: A group of travelers in the Southwest band together to search for gold on Indian burial grounds. Convict Ben Trask attempts to maintain order within the group as they are faced with greed and danger.

Title: 74. Maximka
description: Saved by Russian sailors black boy turned out to be the smart and kind nipper.

Title: 75. Phantom from Space
description: When an asteroid crashes, the search begins to track down the mysterious aliens.

Title: 76. Knights of the Round Table
description: King Arthur's rule is threatened by the adulterous love between Sir Lancelot and Queen Guinevere, a relationship the king's enemies hope to exploit.

Title: 77. The Moon Is Blue
description: Two aging playboys are both after the same attractive young woman, but she fends them off by claiming that she plans to remain a virgin until her wedding night. Both men determine to find a way around her objections.

Title: 78. The Master of Ballantrae
description: Two noble Scottish brothers deliberately take opposite sides when Bonnie Prince Charlie returns to claim the throne of Scotland in order to preserve the family fortune.

Title: 79. The 5,000 Fingers of Dr. T.
description: A young boy dreams that he is in an imaginary world where, assisted by his family's plumber, he must save other piano-playing kids like himself from the dungeons of his dictatorial piano teacher who also mind-controls his mother.

Title: 80. Gun Fury
description: In Arizona, Frank Slayton's gang robs a stagecoach and kidnaps Ben Warren's fiancée, prompting Warren to pursue Slayton.

Title: 81. Sins of Jezebel
description: The aging Ahab, king of Israel, comes under the influence of a young and beautiful but scheming pagan woman named Jezebel and, against the warnings of his advisers and the prophet Elijah, marries her. Her plan to introduce her pagan idols to Israel angers God, who decides to wreak vengeance on the land.

Title: 82. Robot Monster
description: The monstrous Ro-Man attempts to annihilate the last family alive on Earth, but finds himself falling for their beautiful daughter.

Title: 83. The Maze
description: A Scotsman named Gerald breaks his engagement to Kitty, moves to his uncle's castle. Kitty and her aunt follow him weeks later, finding Gerald aged.

Title: 84. Blowing Wild
description: In South America, after Jeff Dawson and Dutch Peterson's oil rigs are dynamited by local bandits, the two partners resort to risky transportation of nitroglycerin to raise money.

Title: 85. Island in the Sky
description: A C-47 transport plane, named the Corsair, makes a forced landing in the frozen wastes of Quebec, and the plane's pilot, Captain Dooley, must keep his men alive in deadly conditions while waiting for rescue.

Title: 86. Battle Circus
description: Set in Korea and made during the war, this is the love story of a hard-bitten Army surgeon, and a new nurse ready to save the world.

Title: 87. Cat-Women of the Moon
description: Astronauts travel to the moon where they discover it is inhabited by attractive young women in black tights.

Title: 88. Young Bess
description: The early life of Elizabeth I, from her childhood until her accession to the throne of England in 1558.

Title: 89. Thunder Bay
description: Shrimpers and oilmen clash after an ambitious wildcatter begins constructing an off-shore oil rig.

Title: 90. Gunsmoke
description: A young gunslinger tries to help a rancher and his daughter save their land and cattle from an evil, wealthy land owner.

Title: 91. Trouble Along the Way
description: An ex-football coach is hired by a small Catholic college to train its football team in the hopes of winning games and making money to save the school from bankruptcy.

Title: 92. Salome
description: After her banishment from Rome, Jewish Princess Salome returns to her Roman-ruled native land of Galilee, where prophet John the Baptist preaches against Salome's parents, King Herod and Queen Herodias.

Title: 93. Four Sided Triangle
description: Bill and Robin, helped by, Lena, develop a "reproducer" which can exactly duplicate any object. Bill, crushed when Lena marries Robin, convinces her to allow him to duplicate her, so that he may have a copy of her for himself.

Title: 94. Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
description: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

Title: 95. Dream Wife
description: A business tycoon decides to wed a Middle Eastern princess whose customs dictate the pair must live apart for several months before marrying. Even more complications settle in when the tycoon's ex-fiancée is assigned to chaperone the pair.

Title: 96. 99 River Street
description: A former boxer turned cab driver has to hide from the police after his badgering wife is murdered by the jewel thief she was having an affair with.

Title: 97. Man in the Attic
description: After an enigmatic, self-described pathologist rents the attic room of a Victorian house, his landlady begins to suspect her lodger is Jack the Ripper.

Title: 98. The Man Between
description: In post-WW2 Berlin, when travel to the East was still possible, the sister of a British officer from West Berlin is abducted by Communist agents and taken into the Soviet sector where her eventual rescue is arranged by a German smuggler.

Title: 99. The Titfield Thunderbolt
description: Volunteers take over their local passenger train service (against bus company resistance) when the government announces its closure.

Title: 100. Is Your Honeymoon Really Necessary
description: An American soldier's marital bliss is shattered when his alluring ex-wife resurfaces in England, asserting their marriage's validity. His buddies efforts to help only exacerbate the tangled mess.

Title: 101. The Nebraskan
description: Trying to make peace with the Nebraska Sioux leads frontier scout Wade Harper through many perils.

Title: 102. Do Bigha Zamin
description: In the hope of earning enough money to pay off his debts and save his land, a poor farmer becomes a rickshaw puller in Calcutta and faces many difficulties.

Title: 103. The Stranger Wore a Gun
description: A former spy moves to Arizona to join a gold robbery, but when he gets there decides that it's not for him and tries to change his life.

Title: 104. Scared Stiff
description: Fleeing a murder charge, a busboy and a nightclub singer wind up on a spooky Caribbean island inherited by a young woman.

Title: 105. The Caddy
description: Although gifted golfer Harvey Miller is too nervous to golf in public tournaments, he acts as coach and caddy for friend Joe Anthony.

Title: 106. Too Young for Love
description: Andrea and Annetta are two fifteen year olds from very different families. They love each other and find in their love a refuge from the evils and problems of the world. However, the real troubles begin when the girl becomes pregnant.

Title: 107. The Desert Rats
description: Richard Burton plays a Scottish Army officer put in charge of a disparate band of ANZAC troops on the perimeter of Tobruk with the German Army doing their best to dislodge them.

Title: 108. Houdini
description: From his beginnings as a "wildman" carnival act to the internationally famous feat of escaping from a locked trunk in an ice-jammed river, the great Harry Houdini emerged as the world's most captivating magician and escape artist.

Title: 109. The Actress
description: This is an account of the real life experience of actress/playwright Ruth Gordon. The story of Ruth Gordon's early struggles on the road to stage stardom.

Title: 110. Law and Order
description: Frame Johnson already cleaned up Tombstone and hopes to settle down near Cottonwood. But a marshal's work is never done.

Title: 111. Shoot First
description: A retired U.S. Army Colonel living in England stumbles upon a spy ring when he shoots buckshot at a poacher during a hunt.

Title: 112. Thunder Over the Plains
description: In Post-Bellum Texas, an army captain tries to keep the peace between overtaxed, impoverished farmers and greedy carpetbaggers.

Title: 113. Malta Story
description: 1942 and the island of Malta is battling for survival. The threat of invasion by Axis forces is increasing as air raids wear down its defence. Entering this maelstrom is Flight Lieutenant Peter Ross, an RAF photo-reconnaissance pilot.

Title: 114. Never Let Me Go
description: An American reporter stationed in post-war Moscow marries a ballet dancer, but their relationship is threatened by the country's political volatility.

Title: 115. City Beneath the Sea
description: Two American divers are distracted by fair ladies and skulduggery while trying to salvage a gold ship off Jamaica.

Title: 116. Escape from Fort Bravo
description: During the Civil War, a group of Confederates escapes from the Union POW camp at Fort Bravo but has to contend with the desert, the Mescalero Apaches and the pursuing Union troops.

Title: 117. Genevieve
description: Two British couples pit their vintage automobiles against each other in an exciting cross-country race.

Title: 118. Man on a Tightrope
description: A Czech circus owner and clown and his entire troupe employ a daring stratagem in order to escape en masse from behind the Iron Curtain.

Title: 119. Recoil
description: Jean Talbot poses as a crook to infiltrate the gang of thieves who killed her jeweler father, Michael.

Title: 120. Project Moon Base
description: A saboteur posing as a scientist strives to destroy the world's first space station.

Title: 121. The Sword and the Rose
description: During the reign of Henry VIII, Mary Tudor seeks to flee a forced marriage with the French king by escaping to America with her true love, but her plans are not so easily executed.

Title: 122. Sea Devils
description: Gilliatt, a fisherman-turned-smuggler on Guernsey is offered a pardon if he agrees to sail to France on his ship the Sea Devil, to rescue Droucette, an English agent whose cover has been blown, and who has now been jailed.

Title: 123. Abbott and Costello Go to Mars
description: Two workmen accidentally launch a space rocket intended for Mars, and find mistakenly landing in New Orleans just the beginning of their misadventures.

Title: 125. Welcome Mr. Marshall!
description: After finding out that North American people are visiting the Spanish villages, the citizens of Villar del Río start preparing themselves to welcome them when they arrive.

Title: 126. The Twonky
description: Tweedy college professor discovers his new TV set is animate, apparently possessed by something from the future, and militantly intent on regulating his daily life.

Title: 127. Roadhouse Girl
description: The wife of the garage owner is caught with the mechanic, when he is accidentally killed and a cover up begins.

Title: 128. I Love Melvin
description: Melvin, a photographer for "Look" magazine, meets Judy and wants to marry her. Her father is against that and as a last resort, Melvin promises to get Judy's photo on the cover of the next issue, a task easier said than done.

Title: 129. Turn the Key Softly
description: Follows three women through their first day of freedom after they are released from prison.

Title: 130. So Big
description: In the late 1890s, a young widow becomes a successful farmer and can send her son, nicknamed 'So Big', to college. After graduating, he finds a job as an architect, but forgoes his dream in favor of an immediate financial success.

Title: 131. All I Desire
description: In 1910, a wayward mother re-visits the family she deserted.

Title: 132. The Sun Shines Bright
description: William Pittman Priest has to use all his wiles to retain his position as judge in his Kentucky hometown, while continuing to be a voice for the town's underclass and for democratic values.

Title: 133. Donovan's Brain
description: Three scientists unlawfully remove the still living brain of a dead tycoon and experiment with it but the evil brain begins to telepathically control the lead scientist.

Title: 134. Skanderbeg
description: This is the true story of the national hero of Albania, George Kastrioti Skanderbeg, from his birth to his death (1405-1468). Based mainly upon the monk writer Marin Barleti, the movie starts off with how the boy Skanderbeg was taken hostage by the Ottoman Turks and trained by them until he became one of the most outstanding warriors of the Ottoman Empire, then later returned home to his country to organize the oppressed Albanians into a fierce and heroic resistance for over 30 years. After converting from Islam to Christianity (the religion of his ancestors) he managed to keep the greatest empire on earth at the time from invading Albania. His story is an inspiration to generations of Albanians, wherever they live.

Title: 135. Arena
description: Rodeo rider's marriage is endangered because of his commitment to the sport.

Title: 136. Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A self-righteous missionary man seeks to save the soul of a former prostitute.

Title: 137. Destination Gobi
description: In 1944, US Navy specialists run a weather station in the Gobi desert where they are harassed by Japanese warplanes but aided by local Mongol nomads.

Title: 138. Spaceways
description: British scientists test rocket; matrimonial strife looms. Rocket partially fails; couple goes missing. Did they elope or are they dead, orbiting in rocket debris?

Title: 139. Inferno
description: A tough, hard-driving business tycoon suffers a broken leg and is left to die in the desert by his scheming wife and her greedy lover.

Title: 140. Terror Street
description: An American pilot AWOL from the states is framed for his wife's murder and has just 36 hours to prove his innocence.

Title: 141. Rob Roy: The Highland Rogue
description: The wartime adventures of Scottish Highland leader Rob Roy MacGregor during the reign of King George I in the 18th century.

Title: 142. I dur och skur
description: Sid Hassler is a theater manager and song writer who can't find the inspiration to create new song numbers.

Title: 143. Let's Do It Again
description: In this musical remake of "The Awful Truth", the wife of a womanizing composer sets out to give him a dose of his own medicine by having her own affair, but her ploy only leads to divorce. They each then try to make the other jealous.

Title: 144. The Limping Man
description: An American WWII veteran goes back to England after the war only to discover that his wartime sweetheart has got mixed up with a dangerous spy ring.

Title: 145. The Living Desert
description: Although first glance reveals little more than stones and sand, the desert is alive. Witness moving rocks, spitting mud pots, gorgeous flowers and the never-ending battle for survival between creatures of every shape, size and description.

Title: 146. Three Steps in the Dark
description: A country house, a patriarch, a fallout among siblings, a butler, a housemaid--and each of them have secrets: a perfect setting for a classic whodunnit.

Title: 147. City That Never Sleeps
description: Johnny Kelly, who plans on resigning from the police force and leaving his wife the next day, has a very eventful last night on duty.

Title: 148. Man in the Dark
description: Many interested parties are after the loot from a factory payroll heist but the mobster who hid it has amnesia after undergoing experimental brain surgery in the prison hospital.

Title: 149. The Vanquished
description: A trilogy of stories of well-off youths who commit murders. In the French episode, a group of high school students kill one of their colleagues for his money. In the Italian episode, a university student's involved in smuggling cigarettes. In the English episode, a lazy poet finds the body of a woman on the downs, and tries to sell his story to the press.

Title: 150. The Steel Lady
description: Four stranded oilmen try to cross the Sahara in a found World War II German tank.

Title: 151. Small Town Girl
description: A judge's daughter keeps an eye on a playboy who gets 30 days in jail for speeding.

Title: 152. The Man from the Alamo
description: During the Alamo siege, John Stroud is sent to Ox Bow to protect the townsfolk but, following a massacre, he infiltrates Jess Wade's gang of turncoat renegades supporting the Mexicans.

Title: 153. Return to Paradise
description: An American drifter comes to a remote Polynesian island controlled by a Puritanical missionary and turns the social life of the island upside-down.

Title: 154. Latin Lovers
description: Wealthy heiress Nora suspects men only want her money. In Brazil, she falls for Roberto, believing he's poor, but later discovers he's also wealthy. Despite initial doubts, their mutual wealth allows them to unite happily.

Title: 155. War Arrow
description: Major Howell Brady arrives in Indian Territory in hopes of recruiting peaceful, relocated Seminoles to help the army fight rampaging Kiowas.

Title: 156. The Intruder
description: Ex regimental commander Colonel Merton catches one of his former NCOs burgling his house and investigates to find the reason behind this desperate act.

Title: 157. Devil's Canyon
description: In 1897 Arizona, an ex-marshal is sent to the territorial prison where many of his enemies, among guards and inmates alike, are eager for a chance at payback.

Title: 158. The Adultress
description: A truck driver kills the husband of the woman he loves, and becomes the object of blackmail.

Title: 159. Vice Squad
description: A tough captain investigates a cop shooting and stumbles upon a bank robbery plot. He's not afraid to bend rules to get results, using questionable tactics on witnesses and informants while balancing routine police work with major cases.

Title: 160. Appointment in Honduras
description: A wealthy American couple are hostages on an arduous jungle journey.

Title: 161. The Lady Without Camelias
description: A new starlet is discovered and has ups and downs in Italian films.

Title: 162. Sangaree
description: Lamas plays an indentured servant who rises to power in Georgia shortly after the Revolutionary War.

Title: 163. Money from Home
description: When Herman promises the mob to fix a racing horse in order to pay off his debts, he selects his veterinarian cousin as a patsy to help him but things go awry.

Title: 164. Seminole
description: Working under an evil Major, a cavalry lieutenant recounts his efforts to make peace with the Seminole Indian tribe ruled by Chief Osceola his longtime friend who loves the same woman as he.

Title: 165. Captain Scarface
description: A man desperate to leave South America books passage on a freighter, and learns that the captain has made plans to force a scientist to participate in a mission of destruction.

Title: 166. Ride, Vaquero!
description: Two outlaws, Rio and Esqueda, raised together as stepbrothers, have a showdown over the issue of whether to evict new settlers from their territory.

Title: 167. Powder River
description: In 1875, ex-lawman Chino Bull becomes temporary town marshal when his gold prospecting partner is robbed and killed in Powder River country but Chino runs into the murderous Logan brothers.

Title: 168. The Straw Man
description: Insurance investigator Clifford Evans, investigates murderer on Death Row, insured by his company.

Title: 169. A Lion Is in the Streets
description: A charismatic peddler from the bayous finds his true calling in politics. Is he a demagogue in the making?

Title: 170. The Heart of the Matter
description: An unhappily married British security officer stationed in Sierra Leone during World War II falls in love with a young Austrian woman and starts an affair. He soon starts feeling guilty.

Title: 171. The French Line
description: When her fiancé leaves her, an oil heiress takes a cruise incognito in order to find a man who will love her for herself and not for her money.

Title: 172. Three Sailors and a Girl
description: Three navy men run into a shady producer who convinces them to invest into his new show. When they meet the show's female star attraction, they're sold. Have they become the latest showbiz players or just three more suckers?

Title: 173. Second Chance
description: Mobster Vic Spalato's ex-girlfriend Clare is in hiding in Mexico and she's willing to testify for a US Senate investigation committee, if she can make it back to the US alive.

Title: 174. Two Careful Fellows
description: Two best friends clash when one marries the girlfriend of the other.

Title: 175. The Neanderthal Man
description: Professor Groves, an expert in prehistoric life, proves his theories with an extract that'll regress a cat to a saber-tooth tiger and man to a Neanderthal.

Title: 176. Personal Affair
description: In a 1950s British village, a teenager, who is in love with her Latin language teacher, disappears, prompting the police to investigate the teacher, amidst public rumors of rape and murder.

Title: 177. Pony Express
description: Buffalo Bill and Wild Bill Hickock work to establish the Pony Express and fight Indians and California Separatists who seek to destroy it.

Title: 178. Give a Girl a Break
description: Broadway choreographer Ted Sturgis auditions dancers for a new musical after the lead walks out, with talent ranging from a ballerina to an untrained novice and his former partner, a retired star.

Title: 179. The Unfaithfuls
description: An industrialist has his wife tailed because he secretly hopes she is betraying him so that he can ask for a divorce and marry the model he's fallen in love with. This leads to a series of thefts, blackmail and a suicide as well.

Title: 180. The Vanquished
description: After the Civil War, unscrupulous and corrupt civilian administrators, backed by the Union Army, run Southern towns like despots, causing public outrage.

Title: 181. Arrowhead
description: Chief of Scouts Ed Bannon works for the US Army at Fort Clark, Texas and he dreams of aiding in bringing peace to the region, despite opposition from both the Army and the Apaches.

Title: 182. The President's Lady
description: The story of president Andrew Jackson from his early years, the film begins when he meets Rachel Donaldson Robards. The plot concentrates on the scandal concerning the legality of their marriage and how they overcame the difficulties.

Title: 183. Dangerous When Wet
description: With her promoter-trainer and family in tow, Katie Higgins swims her way from the Arkansas Ozarks to foggy London and the English Channel. - SimonJack

Title: 184. Split Second
description: Three hardened criminals take hostages and hide in a Nevada mining ghost town, knowing that an atom bomb is scheduled to be tested there the next morning.

Title: 185. El señor fotógrafo
description: An apprentice of photography is accidentally involved in a n international complot.

Title: 186. The Captain's Paradise
description: The captain of a ferry boat between the restricted British colony in Gibraltar and Spanish Morocco has a woman of differing appeal and temperament in each port.

Title: 187. The Man from Cairo
description: An American tourist, who served in Algeria during WW2, is mistaken for an American agent hired by the French government to recover its gold reserves that went missing in the Algerian desert during the war.

Title: 188. The Charge at Feather River
description: In Colorado territory, Miles Archer is asked by the cavalry at Fort Bellows to aid in rescuing two white women abducted by the Cheyenne and to provide security for the railroad construction teams.

Title: 189. Project M7
description: A secret jet aircraft capable of traveling three times the speed of sound is being developed by a group of scientists secretly. On the day of the test flight, one of the scientists dies in a mysterious accident, and there are many arguments concerning the flight itself; some think it should be ground-controlled while Heathley (James Donald) wants it to be a manned flight with himself at the controls. Conflict also arises when one of his fellow scientists, taking advantage of Heathley's lack of attention toward his wife, Lydia (Phyllis Calvert), makes some moves on her. Then there is the question of just who is the enemy agent on the project. The single-minded Heathly, much to his dismay and little to his credit, uncovers him when he chooses his co-pilot.

Title: 190. Love in the City
description: Six separate episodes: would-be suicides discuss their despair. A provincial dance hall. An investigative reporter posing as a husband-to-be. A young unwed mother. Girl-watching techniques of Italian men. A glimpse into prostitution.

Title: 191. Tumbleweed
description: When a wagon train is wiped-out by the Yaqui Indians, the surviving guide Jim Harvey is accused of desertion and cowardice but Jim escapes the town jail in search of the truth.

Title: 192. Plunder of the Sun
description: American adventurer gets involved in archaeological artifact smuggling and treasure hunting in Mexico.

Title: 193. Commando Cody: Sky Marshal of the Universe
description: Dangerous climate changes are ravaging Earth and the U.S. government requests an investigation by masked super-scientist Commando Cody. He discovers that the disasters are being caused by space-alien forces from unknown planetary origins.

Title: 194. Here Come the Girls
description: A clumsy, full-of-himself chorus boy gets a chance at Broadway stardom when he's a stand-in for a leading actor threatened by an infamous killer.

Title: 195. The Glass Web
description: A beautiful but heartless television actress uses seduction and tricks to blackmail the men in her life to a point where she could get herself killed.

Title: 196. Hidden in the Fog
description: Lora is driving away from her life. At the same time her husband is found dead in their villa.

Title: 197. Take the High Ground!
description: In 1953 at Fort Bliss, Texas, two Korean War combat veterans work as drill sergeants and fall in love with the same woman.

Title: 198. Terror on a Train
description: After a terrorist plants a bomb on board a train, the police call in an army bomb disposal expert to find and dismantle it, but once it has been made safe, he has another shock in store.

Title: 199. The Glass Wall
description: Peter is a refugee who wants to make a better life for himself in America, but he doesn't have the proper papers. Desperate for entry, he jumps ship and flees to New York to search for a World War II veteran whom he helped during the war.

Title: 200. Tarzan and the She-Devil
description: Ivory poachers, headed by Lyra the She-Devil, Vargo and Fidel, capture a native tribe to carry their loot. Tarzan intervenes and is captured.

Title: 201. Francis Covers the Big Town
description: A man who has a talking mule gets a job on a newspaper, and both get mixed up in a murder trial.

Title: 202. Sadko
description: Arriving home to find his native land under the yoke of corrupt merchants, an adventurer named Sadko sets sail in search of a mythical bird of happiness.

Title: 203. The Girl on the Roof
description: Actress Patty O'Neill meets playboy architect Donald Gresham on the observation deck of the Empire State Building and accepts his invitation to join him for drinks and dinner in his apartment.

Title: 204. A Day to Remember
description: A group of men from a London pub are going on a darts team outing to Boulogne. Some members of the party have different reasons for going and get involved in various adventures.

Title: 205. A Geisha
description: A seasoned geisha and her apprentice maiko are forced to give in to their clients' sexual advances to survive.

Title: 206. The Return of Don Camillo
description: Energetic priest Don Camillo returns to the town of Brescello for more political and personal duels with Communist mayor Peppone.

Title: 207. The Lone Hand
description: In 1870, widowed farmer Zachary Hallock secretly joins a group of outlaws as a solution to his money problems.

Title: 208. Act of Love
description: A former soldier on holiday in the French Riviera recalls his time in France during WWII, and his love for a French peasant woman.

Title: 209. The Conquest of Everest
description: Documentary that covers the famous and successful expedition of the Everest conquest by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary, the first climbers to reach its peak.

Title: 210. Innocents in Paris
description: A weekend trip to Paris affects the lives of a group of British tourists.

Title: 211. She Couldn't Say No
description: A wealthy heiress returns to a small Arkansas town to furtively reward the townsfolk who helped to save her life when she was a young girl.

Title: 212. Torch Song
description: A tough but unhappy Broadway star re-evaluates her life when she crosses paths with a blind pianist.

Title: 213. White Fire
description: In London, American Gregor Stevens searches for his convicted murderer brother facing execution. He allies with smuggler Yvonne Durante to prove his brother's innocence, putting her at risk from her criminal associates.

Title: 214. It Happens Every Thursday
description: A New York couple takes over a small town newspaper.

Title: 215. Aida
description: "Aida", featuring Sophia Loren, is a film adaptation of the opera written by Verdi. The plot revolves around the character Radames who falls in love with what he thinks is a slave in a country his armies has conquered. The young woman is really the daughter of the leader he ousted.

Title: 216. Love Letter
description: Explores the wounds of war, the limits of love and the need to forgive. A sad and troubled man, Reikichi Mayumi finds a new job five years after the end of WWII, where he writes love letters for other people.

Title: 217. Break to Freedom
description: In 1944, at a POW camp in Germany the Allied prisoners use a dummy prop named Albert to fool the German guards and escape.

Title: 218. Gilbert and Sullivan
description: The Victorian-era theatrical partnership of English librettist William S. Gilbert and English composer Arthur Sullivan produced fourteen comic operas to great public acclaim, yet they clashed on both personal and creative levels.

Title: 219. Violated
description: Psycho stalks the streets of Greenwich Village, killing and scalping his victims.

Title: 220. The Adventures of Sadie
description: After a cruise ship emergency, a spoiled rich attractive female passenger and three men are marooned on a deserted island where the men compete for her favors.

Title: 221. Aventura en Río
description: While on vacation in Rio de Janeiro, the wife of a respectable Mexican physician becomes amnesic and ends up as a gangster's moll and entertainer at a night club.

Title: 222. One Girl's Confession
description: Another of the "Fate and Irony" films from director-writer-producer-actor Hugo Haas but this one has less hair-shirt torment than most of his offerings, although his camera, as usual, lingers provocatively on the contours of the leading lady and, in this case, she is more than well-contoured. Mary Adams works in a tawdry waterfront restaurant where the owner not only maltreats her, he also cheated her father out of a fortune years ago. The owner acquires $25,000 in an illegal transaction, which Mary promptly steals, hides, confesses to and serves a short sentence. Freed, she goes to work in a restaurant owned by Dragomie Damitrod, and when he gets into trouble over a gambling debt, she offers to help him by telling him where the $25,000 is hidden, and will loan him what he needs. But circumstances indicate he has stolen all of the money, so she clouts him on the head, apparently killing him. She then learns he didn't steal the money, digs it up and donates it to an orphanage, and surrenders to the police, where she learns that Damitrod is not dead. All is not lost as she seems to be heading for matrimony with fisherman Johnny, who has been hanging around romancing her at her various jobs between jail stints.

Title: 223. Meet Me at the Fair
description: In 1904, Doc Tilbee, medicine show huckster and champion tall-tale teller, gives a ride to a young boy escaped from an orphanage, where bad conditions (the result of political graft) are being investigated by new appointee Zerelda Wing, who doesn't know that her fiancée is one of the politicians responsible. Tad wants to stay with his new friend Doc, who is attracted to Zerelda, to the discomfiture of his old flame Clara...all amid nostalgic musical numbers.

Title: 224. South Sea Woman
description: AWOL marine Sgt. Jim O'Hearn is court-martialed for a variety of offenses that carry 143 years in the stockade or the death penalty but refuses to aid in his own defense.

Title: 225. Bad for Each Other
description: A doctor returning from the Korean War to his hometown in Pennsylvania must choose what next to do with his life.

Title: 226. Last of the Comanches
description: The remnants of a massacred cavalry troop and ragtag group of stagecoach passengers fight for survival against fierce Comanches at a desert ruin.

Title: 227. The Golden Blade
description: Basra merchant Harun Al-Rashid avenges his father's murder in this adventure set in ancient Bagdad and inspired from the Arabic fairy tales of One Thousand and One Nights.

Title: 228. The Beggar's Opera
description: When the composer of an opera about a swashbuckling, wenching highwayman meets his hero's real-life counterpart, he's disappointed with his lack of dash.

Title: 229. Trouble in Store
description: Norman, a stockroom worker at a London store, aspires to be a window dresser. Pursuing his dream, he falls for a shopgirl and they uncover a robbery plot, miraculously foiling the thieves.

Title: 230. Code Two
description: The adventures of motorcycle cops, from their academy days, to chasing crooked truckers.

Title: 231. Will Any Gentleman...?
description: After a mix-up at a music hall, a henpecked bank clerk who lives a dreary existence in suburban London finds himself onstage with ambiguously foreign magician Mendoza, who hypnotizes him into losing all of his inhibitions.

Title: 232. Sombrero
description: Three love stories unfold amid a village feud: Charisse and Jason share a tender romance, Gassman and DeCarlo face tragedy, while Angeli and Montalban navigate a joyful relationship.

Title: 233. Easy to Love
description: An aquatic performer tries to attract the man she loves.

Title: 234. The Life and Music of Giuseppe Verdi
description: The life and loves of great composer Giuseppe Verdi are played against a background of the great operas of the 19th Century. A tender love story of his successful and turbulent life, with more than 20 excerpts from his acclaimed operas.

Title: 235. Man in Hiding
description: A wrongly convicted murderer escapes prison to find the real killer.

Title: 236. Woman They Almost Lynched
description: Laying on the Missouri-Arkansas border, the neutral Border City, its female mayor and city council take no side in the ongoing Civil War and they're prepared to hang any troublemaker, Yankee or Confederate, who stirs the townsfolk up.

Title: 237. Girl on the Run
description: Police investigate a murder that occurred in a burlesque theater.

Title: 238. La vierge du Rhin
description: Reported missing in 1940, Jacques Ledru comes back to Strasbourg as Martin Schmidt. He tracks down his wife Genevieve, but she's remarried and has taken the head of his shipping company. She and her husband will do anything to get rid of Jacques and keep his company.

Title: 239. The Clown
description: Former Ziegfeld star Dodo Delwyn now performs as a clown due to alcoholism. His son Dink's faith in him and a brief separation inspire Dodo to accept a TV opportunity arranged by his former agent Goldie.

Title: 240. The Last Posse
description: After a disgruntled rancher, his brother and son rob a rival rancher, the town forms a posse to go after the culprits but the ensuing events are muddled by unclear facts, false testimony, old scores, murder and stolen money.

Title: 241. Scandal at Scourie
description: After their orphanage burns down, a group of children are being transported west by train to Manitoba. All of them are available for adoption and at a stop at Scourie, Ontario little Patsy meets Victoria McChesney. Victoria and her husband Patrick have no children and she immediately decides to adopt the girl. The only condition imposed on them is that as Patsy has been baptized a Roman Catholic the Protestant McChesneys agree to raise her as a Catholic. Patsy is a well-behaved little girl whose only real problem is a school bully, also one of the orphans, who spreads stories that she set their orphanage on fire. Problems arise when the local newspaper goes after Patrick, the town reeve and prominent member of his political party. Patrick decides they can't go forward with the adoption. Patsy overhears him and runs away but does so just as the school catches fire. The community quickly decides Patsy is responsible but it's Patrick who comes to her defense. It all ends well.

Title: 242. The Proud and the Beautiful
description: Life in a small Mexican village where joy and misery, hope and pain, passion and guilt, love and decay, life and death are mixed in the peasants life and two French citizens who end up stranded in there, during a typhoid epidemic.

Title: 243. Paratrooper
description: In 1940, an American claiming to be Canadian volunteers for the British Army's paratroop school.

Title: 244. All the Brothers Were Valiant
description: In the South Pacific islands, two brothers, one good and one bad, fight over the same girl and over a bag of pearls.

Title: 245. Forbidden
description: Eddie Darrow, seeking a mobster's widow in Macao, gets involved in a casino owner's affairs.

Title: 246. The Moonlighter
description: A cattle herder turned rustler runs from a lynch mob and falls, again, for an ex-lover.

Title: 247. Column South
description: Before the Civil War, Lt. Jed Sayre's efforts to conciliate the cavalry and the Navajo are undermined by his racist C.O. and Confederate sympathizers.

Title: 248. Sailor of the King
description: In 1940, Canadian sailor Andrew Brown is prisoner on a battle damaged German raider and he plans to delay the raider's at-sea repairs until a British naval task-force can destroy it.

Title: 249. Sabre Jet
description: The story of jet pilots flying over Korea by day, from their Itazuke Air Base in Japan, and of their wives, on station with them, who have dinner ready when they return. Jane Carter (Coleen Gray), a reporter for a large newspaper syndicate arrives... she's also the estranged wife of the assistant squadron commander, Colonel Gil Manton (Robert Stack.) At first, she goes at her assignment of getting a story on the pilots wives with the same ruthlessness and persistence that broke up her marriage - but a mirror isn't needed to peek around the corner to where this one is headed.

Title: 250. Father of Four
description: Denmarks most popular film family is ready. Ole has some problems at school and Søs feels like she has to take action, but her actions doesn't come without consequences

Title: 251. Flight to Tangier
description: During the Cold War, a mysterious plane carrying $3 million arrives at Tangier airport, and various interested parties try to grab the cash.

Title: 252. Bad Blonde
description: A scheming blonde seduces a fighter and convinces him to murder her husband, a fight manager.

Title: 253. Death Goes to School
description: A Teacher is murdered at an all girls school. Police investigate and discover that the staff room is full of suspects.

Title: 254. Never Wave at a WAC
description: A shallow society matron is urged by her senator father to join the Women's Army Corps.

Title: 255. The Girl Who Had Everything
description: Attorney's daughter falls for one of his gangster clients.

Title: 256. La segunda mujer
description: The singer Rodolfo Salazar enters a room. He finds her second wife Victoria and her twenty-something son Rudy murdered, so he suspects her.

Title: 257. Jennifer
description: Agnes Langley gets a job, through Jim Hollis, as caretaker of an old and vacated estate. The owner's cousin, Jennifer, was the last occupant and mysteriously disappeared. Agnes soon begins to believe that Jennifer was murdered and that Jim, whom she has fallen in love with, is responsible.

Title: 258. Little Boy Lost
description: A war correspondent who was stationed in Paris during World War II married a French girl who was murdered by the Germans. After the war he returns to to try to find his son, whom he lost during a bombing raid but who he has been told is living in an orphanage in Paris.

Title: 259. The Slasher
description: The life of a juvenile delinquent is threatened by his own incessant desire for trouble.

Title: 260. Treasure of the Golden Condor
description: In the 18th century France, Jean-Paul, who was cheated out of his inheritance, land and titles by his uncle, decides to go to Guatemala in search of a famed Mayan treasure.

Title: 261. Wings of the Hawk
description: During the Mexican revolution of 1910, an American prospector gets involved with the revolutionaries after a corrupt Mexican official confiscates his mine.

Title: 262. East of Sumatra
description: Tough Duke Mullane tries to open a new mine in the jungle, but the natives turn hostile...except for one lissome dancer.

Title: 263. Flight Nurse
description: During the Korean War, a United States Air Force nurse with the Medical Air Evacuation Unit flies on C-47 transport aircraft based in Japan where she ferries servicemen wounded in combat.

Title: 264. The Affairs of Dobie Gillis
description: Pansy is sent off broken-hearted to an eastern school, but with help from Happy Stella Kowalski's all-girl band, several hundred students, and an enraged police force, Dobie secures Pansy's return to Grainbelt.

Title: 265. La domenica della buona gente
description: In the background of the football match Roma - Napoli different stories intertwine.

Title: 266. The Juggler
description: In 1949, former concentration camp inmate and Berlin native Hans Muller, immigrates to Israel where, due to psychological problems, he can't adjust to peacetime life.

Title: 267. White Witch Doctor
description: In 1907, a nurse arrives in the Belgian Congo to work for a missionary doctor but meets a grumpy animal hunter who secretly plans to search for gold in the dangerous Bakuba tribal region.

Title: 268. City of Bad Men
description: After six years spent in Mexico, a penniless Brett Stanton and his gang return to Carson City intending to make a quick dishonest buck.

Title: 269. Those Redheads from Seattle
description: A woman takes her four beautiful daughters to Dawson City, Yukon during the Gold Rush to find their fortune.

Title: 270. Deadly Nightshade
description: Escapee switches identities but finds the new one quite a handful.

Title: 271. The Mississippi Gambler
description: In 1854 Mississippi, honest riverboat card gambler Mark Fallon wins young Laurent Dureau's diamond necklace, a family heirloom which, in the end, will bring him happiness and tragedy alike.

Title: 272. Bright Road
description: A young teacher helps a troubled student who's fascinated by a caterpillar's metamorphosis. After losing his sister and facing challenges, he proves himself by handling a bee crisis at school.

Title: 273. El niño y la niebla
description: Marta (Dolores del Río) es una mujer que vive obsesionada, ya que su madre y su hermano murieron de esquizofrenia. Temerosa de que la enfermedad sea congénita, sobreprotege hasta el extremo a su único hijo (Alejandro Ciangherotti Jr.). Debido a su obsesión, Marta no se da cuenta que la única afectada psicológicamente en su familia es ella.

Title: 274. We Go to Monte Carlo
description: When a measles epidemic forces the temporary closing of a child care center, the son of a film star and her estranged husband, a concert pianist, is mistakenly delivered to a touring musician.

Title: 275. The Shadow Man
description: Small-time Soho hustler gets caught up in the murder of an ex-girl friend, evades the police and finally helps them to corner the real murderer.

Title: 276. Ambush at Tomahawk Gap
description: An innocent cowboy convicted with three robbers, fresh out of Yuma Territorial Prison, travels with them to get a share of their hidden loot.

Title: 277. Old Czech Legends
description: Excellent stop-motion animation film from one of the best Czech filmmakers, Jirí Trnka. It tells the ancient story of Bohemia, how it was founded by Czech, the Forefather, and a series of legendary episodes of heroes, queens and kings, inspired in a book by Alois Jirásek compiling the Czech myths.

Title: 280. Three Stops to Murder
description: Discharged by his employer, a private eye stays on a jewel theft case after a model with information for him is murdered.

Title: 281. The Girls of Pleasure Island
description: In the spring of 1945, as World War II is coming to a close, dignified strait-laced Englishman Roger Halyard lives on a South Sea atoll with his three daughters, Gloria, Hester and Violet, and the housekeeper, Thelma, who has raised the girls since childhood. Other than their father, the girls have never seen another man. When Halyard is informed that 1,500 U.S. Marines will soon arrive to establish an air base on the island, he's apprehensive over the prospect of his daughters, who have never met another man, being thrown together with 1,500 Marines who haven't seen a woman in months.

Title: 282. Dance Hall Racket
description: A gangster who operates a sleazy dance hall uses a sadistic bodyguard to keep his girls afraid and his customers in line.

Title: 283. King of the Khyber Rifles
description: A half-caste British officer in 19th-century India battles the prejudices of both his Army colleagues and the local populace while trying to help put down a rebellion led by a greedy local ruler.

Title: 284. Wicked Woman
description: Drifting floozy Billie Nash gets a bar job where she seduces the owner's husband by convincing him to defraud his drunkard wife in order to elope together to Mexico, but a sleazy neighbor with designs on Billie jeopardizes her plans.

Title: 285. The Desert Song
description: A French professor secretly reads a band of desert freedom fighters.

Title: 286. Wenn der weiße Flieder wieder blüht
description: Married couple Willy and Therese go separate ways. Willy leaves town and returns years later as a famous singer. But Therese is about to marry her best friend Peter. Little does Willy know that he and Therese have a now teen-aged daughter.

Title: 287. The Farmer Takes a Wife
description: A romantic triangle develops on Erie Canal boats in 1850.

Title: 288. Parineeta
description: Love blossoms between the son of wealthy man and his middle class neighbor. But their romance is put to the test both by a feud between the families and by the entrance of a rival for the girl's affection.

Title: 289. Count the Hours!
description: Lawyer defends migrant worker falsely accused of two murders.

Title: 290. The Great Sioux Uprising
description: During the Civil War, Southern agitators and a crooked horse dealer endanger the peace between the Union and the Wyoming Sioux.

Title: 291. No Escape
description: When the available evidence in a murder case points to a young woman as the main suspect, her boyfriend, a police detective, arranges for a struggling songwriter who is playing piano in a bar to be blamed for the crime. The girl, knowing that neither she nor the piano player committed the murder, helps him to escape from the police dragnet and try to find the real killer.

Title: 292. Ahí vienen los gorrones
description: A group of lazy, womanizing, alcoholic and just plain lazy friends look for employment after the restaurant they work at closes .

Title: 293. Mästerdetektiven och Rasmus
description: Kalle Blomkvist and his friends intervene when a professor and his little son Rasmus are kidnapped.

Title: 294. The Little Kidnappers
description: Harry and Davy, two orphaned boys raised by authoritarian grandparents in Nova Scotia, yearn for a dog despite their grandfather's stern refusal, mirroring other children's pet ownership.

Title: 295. So This Is Love
description: Biopic of opera star Grace Moore, who was killed in a plane crash in 1947.

Title: 296. Undercover Agent
description: An auditor obtains classified prints/drawings coveted by British govt and others. Villains set traps to retrieve them, capturing him. He's tied to an operating table, facing scalpel torture from the gang leader.

Title: 297. Patita
description: Radha earns a living begging in order to support herself and her crippled and ailing father. They live in a small tenament, under the constant threat of eviction by their landlord for unpaid rent for several months. One day, while begging, Radha meets a young man, Nirmal Chander, who would like to see her improve her status by getting employment, he even goes to the extent of assisting her find work in a mill. He subsequently invites her over to meet his mother, and asks her to marry him, to which she agrees. Nirmal also seeks the permission of her dad. When he goes to get her to make arrangements for their marriage, he finds her and her dad gone. His attempts to locate her are in vain. Then after several months he finds her living in a small dilapidated hut with a young man named Mastram and a child - she calls her own - but claims that she is unmarried. Who is the biological father of this child? Where is he located?

Title: 298. A Slight Case of Larceny
description: Two army buddies down on their luck open up a gas station and get involved in a price war - in a somewhat underhanded way.

Title: 299. Meet Mr. Lucifer
description: A television given as a retirement present is sold on to different households, causing misery each time.

Title: 300. The I Don't Care Girl
description: Producer George Jessel is preparing a film biography of famous musical comedy star Eva Tanguay, but he's told conflicting versions of her road to success.

Title: 301. Poison Ivy
description: FBI Agent Lemmy is sent after a missing two million in Casablanca while mob boss mistress Carlotta plays both sides of the law.

Title: 302. Mister Scoutmaster
description: TV star becomes Boy Scout leader to understand youth and save his failing show. During hikes and adventures, he forms special bond with one young scout despite his snobbish nature.

Title: 303. Dragonfly Squadron
description: In Pusan, shortly before the start of the Korean War, American flight instructors teach South Korean pilots how to fly US-made warplanes.

Title: 304. The Story of Little Mook
description: An old man living in an oriental city tells the story of his life to a group of kids: He too was once a young boy by the name of Little Muck - much like them, but with better manners and a heap of problems. Having lost his father at early age, little Muck is expelled from home by his greedy relatives. He wanders off into the desert hoping to find the merchant who sells good fortune. Amidst the dunes of sand he comes across a small house owned by a wicked woman and her many cats. She wants to make Little Muck her servant, but he manages to escape by stealing a pair of magic shoes which enable him to run faster than any man in the country. From there he heads right into the next set of challenges... Based on a fairy tale by Wilhelm Hauff.

Title: 305. A Japanese Tragedy
description: Alternating in time, between the end of World War II and 1953, Haruko, a widow, does what she can to keep her daughter Utako and son Seiichi safe, fed, and sheltered. By 1953, it's clear that the children, as they enter adulthood, want little to do with their mother. They have a different view of their childhood and her sacrifices: in their eyes, she abandoned them to live a life of pleasure. The self-pitying Haruko is sure her life was one of pain and humiliation, for her children. As Seiichi, now a medical student, announces his plans to let a wealthy man adopt him, and as Utako considers the offer to go away with a married man who is her English teacher, what is left for Haruko?

Title: 306. The Glory Brigade
description: During the Korean War, an American unit of combat engineers must work with Greek troops in order to perform a reconnaissance mission behind Communist lines.

Title: 307. Back to God's Country
description: In north-western Canada,in the 1870s,American schooner captain Peter Keith hopes to return to America with a cargo of furs before winter but two local crooks plan to steal Keith's cargo,boat and wife.

Title: 308. Fort Vengeance
description: Two American brothers chased by a posse cross into Canada and join the Canadian North-West Mounted Police at the height of the Sioux-American war.

Title: 309. Los solterones
description: Abandoned by his wife, Don Gandia, makes an oath, along with his son and daughter, that no one in their town will ever marry. Once grown up, on a family trip to the capital that oath is tested.

Title: 310. The Lost Planet
description: Two newspaper reporters battle a plot by the evil Dr. Grood to conquer the world.

Title: 311. Martin Luther
description: Biopic of German priest Martin Luther (Niall MacGinnis), covering his life between 1505 and 1530 A.D., and the birth of the Protestant Reformation movement.

Title: 312. Laila Majnu
description: Based on the epic tragic love story of Laila and Majnu.

Title: 313. Conquest of Cochise
description: A cavalry officer tries to keep a lid on a volatile situation when Indian leader Cochise is being prodded into starting a war.

Title: 314. Las tres perfectas casadas
description: During their collective marriage anniversaries, three husbands find out their best friend has died and decide to open a letter he left to be opened after his death.

Title: 315. A Virgin in Hollywood
description: A young female newspaper reporter is assigned by her editor to investigate the seamier side of Hollywood.

Title: 316. Ci troviamo in galleria
description: Ignazio Panizza goes from one failure to the other until he meets a singer, Caterina, provided with an exceptional voice.

Title: 317. Pünktchen und Anton
description: Unction und Anton become friends and solve a crime.

Title: 318. Funniest Show on Earth
description: A clown named Tottons of the Togni circus, obliged to never take off his clown makeup or reveal his identity, is continually persecuted by the jealousy of three women and even by a policeman.

Title: 319. The Three Musketeers
description: D'Artagnan and his musketeer comrades must thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu to usurp King Louis XIII's power.

Title: 320. Africa sotto i mari
description: The troublesome daughter of an American millionaire accompanies him aboard his yacht on a deep sea diving expedition in the Red Sea and falls in love with the captain.

Title: 321. Girls' Dormitory
description: Detective Marco is assigned to investigate a murder that has occurred at an exclusive boarding school for adolescent girls. The victim is a popular, wealthy girl found strangled in her bed. The school director tells Marco she expects him to find the killer outside of the school, and she bristles at his insistent interrogations of the school staff and the students. Marco learns that two sadistic games were played the night of the murder and that the victim had been tied up. There are a number of suspects, including a teacher with an unnatural affection for one of the girls; a suspicious Spanish gentleman at the town-inn, and some of the pupils themselves. The dead girl's best friend gives the detective the victim's letters and some films. At a showing of the films, there is a sequence where an elderly, mild-mannered teacher is shown kissing with the disreputable town photographer.

Title: 322. We, the Women
description: Five portraits of actresses in their "common" life, seen as women rather than movie stars.

Title: 323. The Girl Next Door
description: Stage and night club star Jeannie Laird (June Haver) buys her first home, and everyone who is anyone comes to her first garden party only to be blinded by smoke from next door. Jeannie charges over to bawl out her new neighbor and meets comic strip artist Bill Carter (Dan Dailey). Bill has devoted himself to his strip and raising his ten-year-old son Joe (Billy Gray) since the death of his wife. Joe bases his strip on the everyday happenings of him and his son and is proud of keeping it scrupulously honest. After Jeannie and Bill fall in love, young Joe is hurt, especially when Bill starts using a lot of their time to be with Jeannie. Bill cancels a father-son trip to Canada, and Joe decides to write a letter to Bill's syndicate, pointing out that the current plot line of the script being set in Canada isn't honest, since they didn't go.

Title: 325. Spartaco
description: 74 B.C. Somewhere in the Roman Empire, Spartacus, a young officer, is condemned to be a slave because he hit a superior. Brought back to Roma in a gladiators' school, he escapes and stirs up all the slaves in a revolt against the Roman Empire.

Title: 326. Jack Slade
description: When his father is killed in front of him during a stagecoach holdup, a teenage boy vows to rid society of outlaws and he eventually grows into a vicious gunman working for a stagecoach line.

Title: 327. Jamaica Run
description: In Jamaica, amid murder and deceit, a schooner skipper and a land developer search for the sunken ship containing proof regarding the identity of the true heirs of a legendary Jamaican estate.

Title: 328. Raiders of the Seven Seas
description: A legendary pirate captures a Spanish galleon and tries to claim a countess as his bride.

Title: 329. Stolen Identity
description: A jealous concert pianist murders his wife's lover, then frames an innocent taxi driver for the crime.

Title: 330. The Kid from Left Field
description: Former ballplayer Larry Cooper secretly and unofficially manages a struggling major league club, the Bisons, through his nine year old son, Christie, who is a bat-boy for the team.

Title: 331. Wicked Wife
description: Gerald Coates' horse wins Grand National. His wife returns drunk, they argue, she dies accidentally. Coates claims she never returned. Police find train ticket, suspect him. As arrest looms, he gets unexpected help from unknown source.

Title: 332. Les dents longues
description: A young journalist makes his debut in Lyon where he meets a young girl he falls in love with.He has big ambitions , nevertheless he hesitates to go to Paris.

Title: 333. Pepe El Toro
description: A grief-stricken boxer must overcome tragedy in the ring and forge an unlikely friendship on his path to becoming champion, in this final chapter of Mexico's beloved Pepe el Toro trilogy.

Title: 334. Remains to Be Seen
description: Jody Revere (June Allyson) is a band singer working in New York City. Waldo Williams (Van Johnson) is the manager of a fancy apartment house where a murder is committed. The victim is Allyson's wealthy uncle, and since she can't account for her actions at the time of the crime, our heroine is the prime suspect.

Title: 335. Voice of Silence
description: A group of men of differing circumstances and personalities gather at a monastery to undergo a course of spiritual reappraisal. They comprise of a candle-maker, a politician, an ex-prisoner, a novelist and a petty thief trying to elude the police. All have their own spiritual problems to solve, except the thief. The politician, a former partisan leader, suffers the remorse of causing the deaths of three innocent men on a sabotage mission; he is set for the priesthood. The prisoner, a sick and possibly dying man, lacks the courage to visit his wife who is now happily remarried; his padre has advised him to leave her alone. The novelist bears the moral responsibility for offences committed by young people led astray by his writings; he earns a lot for his work, but is too demoralized to continue. Then the candle-maker - miserly, smooth-talking and bigoted - is unlikely to receive any benefit from his retreat to the monastery. Interwoven with the stories of these men is the drama of a priest who, overwhelmed by doubt, still finds the inner force to go forward. In the end the thief repents and leaves the monastery after making an offering to the Madonna of his stolen goods.

Title: 336. Thy Neighbor's Wife
description: Suspicious Raphael Vojnar, a Moravian village judge, makes his young wife Barbara witness the public humiliation of an unfaithful wife who is bound with ropes to a wooden half-cross. He tells Barbara that if he ever catches her with another man he will kill her. This is a certain indicator that the plot is about to thicken and the pot is about to boil. The next day, Barbara meets her old beau, Quirin, who is in town to help his old uncle Sima with the harvest. Vojnar recognizes Quirin as a man he had arrested years earlier. Vojnar, stirring the pot, makes an overnight trip out of town, and Quirin boldly breaks into Barbara's bedroom, where, to the surprise of none, he is warmly received. The surprise comes the next day when old uncle Sima is found stabbed to death. Quirin can not account for his whereabouts without compromising Barbara and,even worse, he has lost his pearl-handled knife and can't prove it wasn't the murder weapon. The judge himself finds the knife in his garden and quickly puts two and two together, but Barbara has bribed the dim-witted maid, Anushka, to say it was she that Quirin was visiting.

Title: 337. All Ashore
description: Three sailors finally get some shore leave, and go in search of fun and girls.

Title: 338. Fatal Desire
description: In Pietro Mascagni's tragic opera, a soldier returns home from war to reclaim his former fiancée, only to find that she's married someone else in his absence, leading to jealousy, betrayal, and murder.

Title: 339. The Wedding of Lilli Marlene
description: War time drama. Lili will not marry her true Love, an American reporter, until she becomes a star. Starring Lisa Daniely, Hugh McDermott and Sid James.

Title: 340. Eva
description: Eva, the scandalous wife of a neglectful businessman, feels trapped. When she begins a torrid affair with a handsome holidaymaker, the weight of passion and sin bears down on them. Will they risk it all for a summer romance?

Title: 341. Fort Ti
description: Set against the backdrop of the French and Indian war in colonial America, the British soldiers attempt to root out the French Army from Fort Ticonderoga.

Title: 342. Siren of Bagdad
description: In ancient Baghdad, a magician uses his powers and his magic box to save slave girls.

Title: 343. A Queen Is Crowned
description: A lavish documentary film of Queen Elizabeth II's Coronation in 1953.

Title: 344. The Ship of Damned Women
description: Isabella's family is noble but half-ruined, so her intended marriage with a dignitary of the kingdom appears as a godsend for all its members. But Isabella finds herself accused of infanticide after killing the baby she was carrying in secret and it is as if the whole sky fell in on the family. That just cannot be. The young woman's parents and perfidious Isabella herself are prepared to do anything to avoid scandal. And they do: they lure Consuelo, Isabella's cousin, into a trap so that it is she who takes the blame for the baby's death. Condemned to ten years of forced labor in a penal colony, Consuelo is embarked, amid over a hundred female convicts, on a special ship. A long, painful and eventful voyage begins.

Title: 345. Desert Legion
description: Paul Lartal of the Foreign Legion meets the princess of a lost city in the Algerian mountains.

Title: 346. Cry of the Hunted
description: A fugitive is pursued by a lawman who is obsessed with his capture.

Title: 347. The Redhead from Wyoming
description: In Wyoming, Sweetwater town sheriff Stan Blaine finds himself in the middle of a range war between greedy cattle barons and newcomer settlers who compete for public lands and unbranded stray cattle.

Title: 348. The 49th Man
description: During the Cold War, the Defense Department's War Games team smuggles 48 nuclear bomb parts into the USA to test the nation's readiness for a subversive attack, but an unexplained 49th bomb part mysteriously turns up.

Title: 349. The Guiding Light
description: 13-year old Bruce Lee plays San, a child up for adoption. Finally accepted by his surrogate parents, he is faced with a dilemma when his real parents show up and want him back.

Title: 350. The Stars Are Singing
description: Fifteen-year-old Katri Walenska jumps a Polish ship, swims ashore and enters New York illegally. The United States Immigration officials are alerted and the search is on. Katri's only possessions are a ten-dollar bill and a letter to her parents' old friend, Jan Poldi, a former Metropolitan Opera star. She finds him in a shabby Greenwich Village apartment. His neighbors in the apartment house are three Broadway hopefuls; pop singer Terry Brennan, hoofer Buddy Fraser and Homer Tirdell and his talented dog Red Dust. (Pardon me, make that four Broadway hopefuls counting the dog.) When Terry hears Katri's magnificent singing voice, she scurries around New York to get her an audition and succeeds in getting her a spot on Don Wilson's televised amateur hour. She wins the contest but unwittingly reveals her true identity as an illegal alien, which causes the arrest of Poldi, Wilson and Dave, Terry's lawyer boyfriend. Katri faces deportation.

Title: 351. Taxi
description: A New York cab driver helps an Irish immigrant with a baby in locating her missing husband.

Title: 352. Song of the Sea
description: In the drought areas of Northeastern of Brazil, groups of migrants move trying to find better place to live, at least with water. Some of them go to Recife, to get a vessel to Santos expecting to have a better life in the Southern. In the poor area of Recife, an old washerwoman launders clothes to survive and support her family. Her husband Zé Luis, a former sailor, is crazy due to a hit of the boom of a mast on his head. Her older son Raimundo works in a grocery and selling mangoes on the street, trying to save money to move to the Southeastern with his girl-friend Aurora. Her daughter wants to be a prostitute to have a better quality of life. Her younger son is seriously sick.

Title: 353. Gitana tenías que ser
description: Pastora, una cantante española, es contratada para filmar una película en México. Después de descartar varios galanes termina por seleccionar a Pablo, un mariachi poco conocido. Durante el rodaje las peleas entre ambos van dando lugar a un profundo amor.

Title: 354. The Veils of Bagdad
description: The Ottoman leadership entrusts Antar with the task of preventing the Pasha of Bagdad from using local leader Mustapha's united hill tribes against the Ottoman Sultan.

Title: 355. The Stand at Apache River
description: At Apache River Station, the passengers of a stagecoach, the owners of the station, a sheriff and his prisoner and a few ferry passengers are besieged by a band of renegade Apaches.

Title: 356. Norman Conquest
