Dancs Meanwhile, the old manager spreads the rumor that the new socialist trade can not meet the demand. Relatives and friends start buying into action, leading to mass hysteria. However, the new store is borne by the customer siege until the arrival of the supply

Title: 635. A Young Woman Missing
description: A young teacher comes back home after a mountain trip, and finds his wife missing. Noone has seen her since the day he left for the trip. The police starts an investigation starts to find out what has happened.

Title: 637. The Big Break
description: Marty (James Lipton) is a shipping clerk in the garment district and a wise guy trying to cut corners and get by on angles, and not very good at it. He meets Helen (Gaby Rodgers) and decides to change his ways, but lack of patience in slow-progress jobs leads him to become involved with a neighborhood gang.

Title: 638. Fløjtespilleren
description: Circus Karla has been on tour in Germany and is now returning to Denmark.

Title: 639. Via Padova 46
description: A bored civil servant accepts an invitation to visit a glamorous young woman. When she doesn't answer her door, and is later found murdered - he panics.

Title: 640. Three Lights and Four Streets
description: There are six sons of which five are married. One of the brides is Tamil.

Title: 641. The Blue Parrot
description: A London Soho nightclub is the focus for an undercover investigation into the murder of a small-time crook.

Title: 642. Red River Shore
description: When an oil discovery is reported at Paxton, Oklahoma, Marshal Rex Allen immediately suspects that where there is oil, there is trouble. Rex arrives just as a band of desperadoes stage a bank hold-up and escape with $25,000 which ranchers have invested in prospective oil drillings. Rex discovers that rancher Frank Barlowe is behind the bogus oil venture which is fleecing the local ranchers. Marlowe is killed in the hectic proceedings and his son, Ned Marlowe, unwittingly carries on the oil deal. Marlowe's secret partner in the hoax, Case Lockwood, convinces Ned that Rex killed his father. Oil is actually discovered on the property and Lockwood, with his attempted land-grab scheme, is tripped up by Rex.

Title: 643. Rahi
description: After leaving British Army Ramesh joins a tea plantation as a supervisor, where he is required to harass Indians. Gradually his heart changes and falls in love with local girl and revolts against his British employer.

Title: 644. Crazylegs
description: The story of the life and career of football star Elroy "Crazylegs" Hirsch (who plays himself).

Title: 645. Noose for a Lady
description: A woman has been sentenced to death by hanging. Her cousin believes she is innocent and he works against time to prove it before she is executed.

Title: 646. The Bandits of Corsica
description: Siamese twins separated at birth retain a psychic link - each feels the other's pain and happiness.

Title: 647. Salto Mortale
description: The daughter of a circus director takes on the heavy responsibility for the circus company after his sudden death. When she falls in love, rivalries threaten to destroy the harmonious community.

Title: 648. Sterne über Colombo
description: The Swedish Princess Yrida enchants the spectators of Germany with attractions of the Circus Busch and is discovered by Maharaja Gowan, who gives the circus an engagement in India in order to be closer to her.

Title: 650. Den gamle mølle paa Mols
description: Who is the father of Annemarie' (Annemette Svendsen) - is it the inn-owner (Ib Schønberg) or the miller (Knud Heglund)? Will she marry the miller's son (Louis Miehe-Renard) without knowing if he is in fact her brother? And who is the mysterious lady (Karen Nellemose) who appears out of nowhere, who snappily turns around the ailing inn and who also knows the true secret about Annemette's birth?

Title: 651. La extraña pasajera
description: During a long train trip, the Police has discovered jewelries in the personal bag of an actress, but she turns out to be innocent.

Title: 652. Çalsin Sazlar Oynasin Kizlar
description: Pistachio and Mistik are two brothers who cannot hold on to any business. Somehow they are responsible for the safety of a casino.

Title: 654. Sea of Lost Ships
description: The son of a deceased Coast Guard hero is raised by a Coast Guard NCO, who also has a son the same age. When they get older both are accepted into the Coast Guard Academy, but the hero's son winds up being thrown out, bringing disgrace to his adopted family.

Title: 655. Chuk and Gek
description: Followed by his two sons, Chuk and Gek, an engineer-explorer heads for a geologists'camp lost in the Ural white wilderness. He plans to spend New Year's Eve there with Chuk and Gek, among his fellow-colleagues. However an undetermined incident has caused the occupiers to leave the place. When, to their amazement, the three adventurers discover the empty camp, they realize that they don't have enough food to return immediately and that they will have to join forces to survive for a few days without any outside help...

Title: 656. Son of Belle Starr
description: The son of the notorious female bandit Belle Starr wants to live an honest life, but finds himself getting drawn into his mother's old profession.

Title: 657. Marry Me Again
description: A pilot discharged from the Korean War is disappointed to discover that his fiancée has since become independently wealthy thanks to a $1 million inheritance.

Title: 658. Caged Women
description: A community center has been built in town for single working women. The massive skyscraper-brick building is called "Women's House". There Isa lives, separated and frozen in his emotional life, and the hostess Ameli, the collective self-proclaimed messenger. The subject of the day is the young theater life Eva Lind, who is in the process of moving in. Most tenants know that she is the cartoonist Tryggve Krook's mistress, one of many over the years. Krook has acquired her apartment in the house, where his wife Anna likewise lives. Anna has for a long time accepted that Tryggve lives his own life and walks as he wishes. The comrades in the house have difficulty in understanding her tolerance, her accused indifference to the man's movements. Isa lives by spotting in short. Ameli is greeting for buying a star; She wants to know if her dwarf stabbing has become pregnant after insemination. The star is, however, affected by Annas humiliation. The card speaks of evil dead death, for the "heart king" and for a young girl. Tryggve will visit the Eve for the first night with a view to staying with Eva. She rushes down to receive him, but accidentally embraces the gatekeeper's ugly and retarded daughter Rosa, who assumes that there is something called love in the world of others, beautiful and talented. The lonely women seek different solutions to their hunger for tenderness and fellowship. Sylvia, the hated fashionista, the happy, busy and reality-fitting never long for any missing cavalry. Be comforting with godliness. Anna lets herself be swallowed up by her victim's role.

Title: 659. Dharma Pathni
description: Shunned shortly after her marriage, a wife is allowed three months to pretend that she is married.

Title: 660. Escape by Night
description: An Italian racketeer on the run in London holes up in a disused theatre with a hard-drinking journalist out to get the full story.

Title: 661. Perils of the Jungle
description: Hunter tracks down lions on the Congo jungle.

Title: 662. Black 13
description: Stephen is the screwed-up son of a college professor who turns to a life of crime after killing a pedestrian in an automobile accident. His crime spurt is petty until one results in the killing of the night watchman at the college. Claire, secretary to the professor, is heads-over about Stephen but he is more interested in a night club entertainer.

Title: 665. Vägen till Klockrike
description: During the latter half of the 1800s, one million people from Sweden emigrated to Northamerica.

Title: 666. Agulha no Palheiro
description: The simple and naive country girl Mariana arrives in Rio de Janeiro from Minas Gerais trying to find her fiancé, José da Silva, with his picture only, and without his phone number or address. She is lodged and welcomed by her simple lower middle class relatives, and sooner they are informed that Mariana is pregnant. The family decides to help her to find José da Silva: her aunt, the kind hearted housewife D. Gisa: her cousins, the bus driver Baiano and the aspirant radio singer Elisa; the family's friend, the street-car driver Eduardo; and their neighbor composer, all of them join Mariana in her almost impossible quest, equivalent to find a needle in a haystack. When the shy Eduardo and the simple Mariana fall in love for each other, José da Silva is finally found. But the winding road of love keeps them together.

Title: 667. King of Skating
description: The throne of ice skating sees a change of regent when Hans takes over as "the king", and the sports press can't seem to get enough of him. The dethroned king gets the negative attention, but also cynically waiting for the new king to fall.

Title: 668. Flukt fra paradiset
description: A bachelor that still lives with his parents is pushed into an engagement agreement that he is not keen on. He decide to postpone it and go on a vacation with an old friend to Paris. A new world opens to him.

Title: 670. As Long as You're Near Me
description: An actress used to playing only bit parts becomes the center of attention when a movie director buys her life story as a film project, she is now faced with a psychological crisis.

Title: 671. Mr. Pu
description: A dark satire of a contemporary Japan still exhausted from the aftermath of war, hunger, poverty and unemployment. And just as its people are recovering, there is a threat during these Cold War years of renewed militarism and rearmament.

Title: 672. Sky Commando
description: During the Korean War, two junior officers discuss their colonel's dour reputation dating back to his WW2 service in the bomber and reconnaissance command.

Title: 673. Legione straniera
description: Alberto Gherardi, a sailor is wrongly suspected of murder, flied and enroll into the Foreign Legion. His unfaithful fiancee Irene goes to look for him with his young brother Enrico, but the latter is killed. Will she still manage to free her lover?

Title: 674. Walt Disney's Hallowe'en Hilarities
description: A package film of Halloween-themed cartoons, one of which being Trick or Treat (1952).

Title: 675. Aas
description: Widower Ashok lives a wealthy lifestyle in Bombay, India, along with his son, Kishore, his paternal aunt, a maid-servant, Chanda, and three other employees. He makes a living running an export-import business near Flora Fountain. One day unattended Kishore runs away, a frantic Ashok complains to the Police and puts up a reward of a thousand Rupees. A young woman named Asha, who lives a poor lifestyle, all by herself, finds Kishore, brings him to the Police Station, where he is picked up by Ashok and taken home. Asha refuses to take any reward money. Shortly thereafter Ashok advertises for the position of a governess, Asha applies, is hired, and moves in to live with them. Soon she and Ashok fall in love, much to the chagrin of Ashok's aunt, who wants him to marry her niece. Ashok gets married with Asha nevertheless, the family live in harmony, and Asha gives birth to a male child, Munna. Thereafter Ashok is told that Asha is neglecting Kishore; a necklace that was inexpensive, but a good omen for Kishore goes missing, and is subsequently found on Munna's bed; and a cat dies after drinking poisoned milk that was meant for Kishore. An angered Ashok blames Asha and asks her to leave, and she picks up Munna and leaves. The question remains: Did Asha really neglect, steal and then try to kill Kishore merely because she became a mother herself or was there some other unknown reason(s)?

Title: 678. Hana no naka no musume-tachi
description: Girls in the Orchard (1953) is about tension between the life of a family in a rural area with all the traditions (continuing family business, taking care of the land)-- and the modernity and lure of a life in the city.

Title: 679. El liss el sharif
description: Ismail Aglati wants to marry Fathiya, but she refuses anyone except him. Her father sends her to her aunt's house to keep her away from Ismail and avoid issues with her arranged marriage to another man.

Title: 681. Halfway to Hell
description: Documentary of war atrocities with newsreel footage of concentration camps.

Title: 682. Epitome
description: Shusei Tokuda's starkly realistic novel about a poor girl pressed into becoming a geisha was forcefully adapted by Kaneto Shindo (Onibaba). When Ginko (Nobuko Otowa, Shindo's wife) falls in love with one of her clients, she is handily rebuffed by the young man's wealthy family, and left to wander from geisha house to geisha house.

Title: 683. Sinhá Moça
description: In 19th century Brazil, young people in the State of São Paulo fight against black slavery and the farmers who support it. Against this backdrop, Sinhá Moça falls in love with a young lawyer, and they get involved in a great love story.

Title: 685. Anna's Sin
description: This is the story of an American Negro actor who goes to Italy to play Othello and falls in love with his Desdemona.

Title: 686. La caraque blonde
description: As in a Hollywood western, rice growers and bull cultivators come into conflict in the Camargue.

Title: 688. Ingeniously Taking Mount Hua
description: The Nationalist army is dug in on Mount Hua and the People's Liberation Army finds a way to attack.

Title: 689. Zalamuni el habaieb
description: A happy family's life collapses after the father loses his fortune through stock-market speculation. After his death, a friend's scheme causes a husband and wife to separate, leaving the wife abandoned and the family facing hardship.

Title: 691. Ved Kongelunden...
description: The good people of a small community in the countryside near Copenhagen enjoy life and find their way to love.

Title: 692. Saginaw Trail
description: Hamilton's Rangers, led by our hero Gene, must keep the Indians in the northern Michigan territory from attacking the settlers.

Title: 693. Uma Pulga na Balança
description: Swindler in jail devises a scheme of blackmailing the family of recently deceased people, threatening to tell supposedly incriminating facts about the dead man's life.

Title: 694. Ein Herz spielt falsch
description: A man, in need of money and too lazy to work for a living, marries a plain but rich girl in the knowledge that she is ill and has not long to live. Once he is married to her, he comes to love her passionately and cannot bear the thought of losing her. In an effort to save her life, he spends all their money, but to no avail. His wife dies and he is once again penniless. However, he is a changed man.

Title: 695. La diosa de Tahití
description: A fugitive hides from justice among smugglers in the deep jungle of an exotic island, but things become complicated when he falls in love with a local cabaret dancer.

Title: 696. The Body Beautiful
description: Susan Morrow, the secretary to Robert Clarke, a model photographer, is upset when her boss pays too much attention to model Noreen Nash. Morrow's younger sister takes a candid photo of her sister in her underwear, with face hidden, and sends it to Clarke. He is intrigued and tries to locate the mystery girl but, meanwhile, enters the photograph in a contest. It wins, provided Clarke can identify the girl. He offers a reward and hires a friend to search for her. Meanwhile, back the agency, Nash offers to pose as the missing girl, but she and Clarke quarrel and she walks out. Rather than leave her boss in a fix, Morrow admits she is the girl in the picture.

Title: 697. Alyosha Ptitsyn vyrabatyvaet kharakter
description: A Moscow schoolboy, third grade student Alyosha Ptitsyn decided to radically change his life: to get rid of the care of his grandmother and sister, not to succumb to temptations and live according to a strict routine. He made up a daily routine and began a new life: he got up, did exercises and went to school .

Title: 699. Eyes of the Jungle
description: Ramar of the Jungle encounters a holy man who warns him of great danger. His friend Professor Howard is near death, cursed by the Mark of Shitan. A sacred golden tablet and a woman ready for sacrifice holds the key to Howard's survival.

Title: 701. The Hell of Jealosy
description: Nabil Abdel Salam (Kamal El Shinnawy) is a young engineer married to Awatef (Zahret Al Ola) with one daughter. He meets Thoraya (Amira Amir), a belly dancer, who, after a quarrel with her mad lover Mamdouh (Mahmoud El Meligy) asks him to follow her to her house and help her pack her things. Mamdouh appears suddenly at the house and confronts Nabil, and events take an irreversible turn.

Title: 702. Yôsei wa hana no nioi gasuru
703. Thought to Kill
description: Compilation of 3 episodes from the TV series "Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. Presents ..." (i) "Thought to Kill" (ii) "Parlour Trick" (iii) "The Five Pound Note".

Title: 704. Girls in the Night
description: A family's efforts to move out of a slum area into a better neighborhood is hampered when their son is accused of the murder of a local blind beggar.

Title: 706. Avvaiyyar
description: This movie is a biography of the great saint and poetess Avvaiyar of the Sangam period from 100 B.C to 250 A.D.

Title: 707. The Slave
description: A young composer is forced to work as a bar pianist. One night he gets hit by a car and is brought to a hospital. Severely injured, he is injected with morphine. He becomes addicted.

Title: 709. El golfo que vio una estrella
description: A night watcher (sereno) adopts a child, but the boy grows up being no good. Then the day before King's festivity the seriously sick daughter of his adoptive father visits with her children, who would gladly give away their presents for their mother's improvement.

Title: 710. Dagohoy
description: Dedicated to the valiant Boholano hero Francisco Dagohoy, this film shows the real causes that impelled the Dagohoy Uprising, the longest revolt in Philippine history.

Title: 711. The Genie
description: A young woman discovers her grandfather owns the true Aladdin's lamp and discovers it's handsome Genie inside as well.

Title: 713. François il contrabbandiere
description: With the police on his trail, a smuggler leaves town for a while. When he returns he falls in love with his boss' daughter, leading to an attempt to kill him.

Title: 716. Summer Jubilee
description: One in a series of 15 "Walt Disney Cartoon Packages" keyed to various seasons. Each package consists of six cartoons with a total running time of approximately 45 minutes. Each group, combined as a feature presentation with a main title, is supported with accessories, including trailer, one-sheets, ad mats, and press books. The complete list includes "New Year's Jamboree", "Winter Hilarities", "Spring Frolics", "Drive-In Frivolities", "Drive-In Capers", "April Fool's Frolics", "Easter Parade", "Summer Jubilee", "Fourth Of July Firecrackers", "Fall Varieties", "Hallowe'en Hilarities", "Election Day Gaieties", "Thanksgiving Day Mirthquakes", and "Christmas Jollities."

Title: 717. Föltámadott a tenger
description: In 1953, the film evokes the 1848-49 periods up to the revolutionary struggle of the internal and external enemies. Petofi start there in the events, even in the ranks of waiver is that Bem's army in order to fight. Bem fights the odds, Gabor Aron cannons knocking the enemy.

Title: 718. Drums of Tahiti
description: An American living in 19th century Tahiti gets involved in intrigue against the French colonial government.

Title: 719. Solstik
description: Vibeke Søgaard arrives at her own hotel. She immediately falls in love with the porter and the love is mutual.

Title: 720. Sword of Granada
description: Swashbuckling adventurer Cesar Romero and his two sidekicks (one male and one female) seek treasure in medieval Spain. They're all adept at swordplay, engaging in combats that are depicted in the 3-D format. Unfortunately, they don't win all of their sword fights, resulting in the heroes spending quite a bit of time in bondage.

Title: 721. Maailman kaunein tyttö
description: Unexpected romance is in the air when a young woman from Finnish boarding school meets an American millionaire.

Title: 723. La voz de mi ciudad
description: Roberto Morán is a provincial newcomer to Buenos Aires, where he works as a factory worker, who plays the bandoneon "by ear" and wants to learn music in a conservatory run by an old frustrated musician, Don Matías.

Title: 724. Tarantella napoletana
description: Combining musical and dance numbers with comedy sketches (performed by members of The Armando Curcio Company and The Gauthier Ballet Troupe)without any plot, this is more of a revue than a movie, along the lines of The Ed Sullivan television series in the U.S. It begins with a puppet show that shows the changes in Naples from the past to the present; a slapstick takeoff on "La Traviat" with local songs substituted for the Verdi music; two men comment on the monotony of life, followed by a Charlie Chaplin impersonator;and a sketch portraying an Italian-American who returns to the old country to marry the simple girl he left behind, only to learn she has assumed many of the qualities of the American women. Along the way, an elaborate ballet sequence created by Mady Odolensky and danced by Claudia Lawrence and Teddy Barnett is tossed in. Armando Curcio wrote the story, book and lyrics.

Title: 727. There Was a Young Lady
description: A super-efficient young secretary foils the plans of a gang of smash-and grab robbers.

Title: 728. A Husband for Anna
description: Anna Zaccheo is a beautiful young woman from a working class Neapolitan family. Her main concern is to find herself a suitable husband. She meets a young sailor Andrea one day and gets engaged to him. But while she is waiting for Andrea to return from the navy she gets raped by her boss. Her life suddenly takes a downward spiral.

Title: 729. Tokai no yokogao
description: A little girl named Michiko gets lost from her mom in the neighborhood of Ginza. A friendly couple, a sign carrier and and a shoe-shine girl, start helping her. The mother is simultaneously looking for the lost child.

Title: 730. Yo soy muy macho
description: To help her pilot brother, Maria disguises as a man to take his place, and must live in the jungle with a very "macho" captain, eventually falling in love.

Title: 731. Ladki
description: Raja lives a wealthy lifestyle with his somewhat upper Caste Hindu, eccentric, woman-hating dad, Hazurdas, and mom. He is friendly with Kishore, and both are aspiring doctors. On their way to college, they meet with two young women, Rani Mehra and Kamini. Both young men fall in love with them, with Raja taking the first initiative and getting married to Kamini, even though she of a lower untouchable Caste, but decides not to tell his parents. When he does inform them, they want him to divorce Kamini and get married to a girl of their choice, Raja refuses and returns back to Kamini, only to find her in the arms of her childhood friend, Sunder. Angered and hurt at this betrayal, he decides to marry the girl his parents have chosen for him - and he is due for another surprise - as the girl he is about to wed is none other than Kamini's friend, Rani. Watch what happens when a liberated, tom-boyish Rani finds out that Raja is already married, and the impact this has on everyone concerned.

Title: 732. Keranir Jiban
description: Keranir Jiban is a social drama which portrays the ups and downs of our main protagonist Mr. Bidhu, his life and his family. He has a happy family with two sons and four daughters and they live together with love. His son Potla was a popular theatre actor with much intelligence and very popular. Mr. Bidhu is the only earning member of his family and he works hard to earn and support his family. Their family goes through many ups and downs in poverty and fight through all their struggles and pains. In the end, Potla falls sick and is diagnosed with T.B. and sadly, he suffers and dies. The movie runs through many emotional layers, social themes of social class and lifestyles of the poor and weak. It teaches the importance of family and hardwork and imparts life advice to accept all that life gives you and take it in your stride to deal with it and carry forward strongly. The story ends with Mr. Bidhu who continues to work hard in life to try and forget his sorrows and sadness and supports his family.

Title: 733. La alegre caravana
description: Miguel, a young adventurer with a good social position, runs away from home to avoid being married off to the woman chosen by his family. In his flight, he hides in a caravan of gypsy carnivals. There he meets Rocío, a beautiful young woman with an extraordinary voice. Miguel will be involved in the adventures of the troupe and, together with them, and incorporated into the show, will go from town to town.

Title: 734. Misión extravagante
description: Bullfighter Victor Mendoza is sent to Buenos Aires to obtain a patent from a distant relative. During the trip a beautiful woman distracts him and he is robbed. From then on he starts an adventure that will take him from Lisbon to Buenos Aires.

Title: 736. Captain Bay-Bay
description: On his wedding day a sea captain recounts his various adventures to his guests.

Title: 737. Beklenen Sarki
description: The story of a teenager who becomes a famous singer with the help of a woman.

Title: 738. Lentävä kalakukko
description: Robbers try to escape using a train from Helsinki to Kuopio.

Title: 739. Les amants de minuit
description: Marcel, rich and alone for Christmas, invite Françoise to celebrate with him. Soon, the fairy tale turns into a bad dream.

Title: 740. Love in Pawn
description: Comedy. A penniless couple Roger (Bernard Braden) and Jean (Barbara Kelly) will get £10,000 if Roger can live a sober and profitable life.

Title: 741. Kanikôsen
description: With Japan already suffering economically at the rise of Hirohito, the Depression adds to the tyrannical bullying by bosses,and outright kidnapping of needed labor. Can the working class achieve solidarity under these conditions?

Title: 742. The World Condemns Them
description: Forced by her lover to sell her body, Renata is saved from a suicide attempt by Paolo Martelli, an engineer. She asks him to help her find a job. When Paolo's wife humiliates her, Renata gains revenge by seducing the woman's husband.

Title: 745. La casa grande
description: A man with a brother swindler, who adores his mother has a dream to see the family together.

Title: 746. Aurat
description: Adil (Premnath) is a dashing, brave young man, full of hope and mindful of the rights of all people, especially the downtrodden. It is this last attribute that ends up putting him in the bad books of the Emperor (Ulhas). The Emperor orders his arrest. But before the soldiers can arrest Adil, he single-handedly rescues the Emperor's bethrothed from a lion. This earns him the gratitude of beautiful Queen-to-be, Juhi (Purnima). The Emperor, pleased with Adil, gives him an important assignment in his army, and promises that Adil's fellow-villagers will not face oppression, taxes or forced labour from his army. Ruhi (Bina Rai) loves Adil, but Adil is unaware of this. Juhi is impressed by Adil and this impression turns to love, and she tells Adil about this. Adil does not think it appropriate for a bethrothed to be his lover and wife, and spurns her. Angered Juhi starts to plot against Adil, by getting the emperor to collect taxes and forced labour from Adil's village. This angers Adil, who goes to confront the emperor and the queen-to-be. Angered, the Emperor dismisses Adil, and orders his arrest. Adil flees to the hills. Numerous attempts by the emperor's armies to apprehend Adil are in vain. Finally, Juhi tells the emperor that she will bring in Adil without spilling a drop of blood. Will Ruhi succeed where so many have failed?

Title: 747. El misterio del carro express
description: The police detective and his brave fiancée, a reporter, are on the trail of the gang that robbed a train.

Title: 749. Mister Kasintahan
description: See - The hilarious adventures of a swooning movie fan when she meets her favorite movie star.

Title: 753. Colonel March Investigates
description: Three episodes of "Colonel March of Scotland Yard" edited together for theatrical release.

Title: 754. Zastava v gorakh
description: Senior Lieutenant Lunin, appointed deputy head, arrives at the border post from Moscow. A gang of Ismail Bek is trying to attack the Soviet territory.

Title: 755. Jirochô sangokushi: tabi garasu jirochô ikka
756. Luz Apagada
description: On a small coastal town, a light-keeper lives in total seclusion after his wife's passing. His daughter is also there and she becomes his only contact with the other locals, and when a helper is sent to assist him on duties, she asks a childhood friend of hers to marry her, so he can be appointed as her father's helper.

Title: 757. Rosa de Alfama
description: Rosa Maria, whose father is a sailor, was picked up by Tomé, having a child of her son Renato, who is expelled from home.

Title: 758. Nadie lo sabrá
description: Pedro Gutiérrez is a modest bank employee who is in financial difficulties and dreams of marrying María. One night, while he is at the office working overtime, Pedro discovers some thieves. After shooting him in the leg, the thieves flee in terror, leaving a bundle of thirty thousand dollars inside the safe. Puzzled, Pedro decides to appropriate the money with the intention of leading a more comfortable life, which will cause him many problems.

Title: 759. Öldüren Sehir
description: Ali is engaged to Selma. When Ali kills someone and goes to prison, Selma's destiny separates from Ali's. Then she falls into a bad way until Ali's exoneration.

Title: 760. Kaibyô Arima goten
description: A courtesan is murdered by jealous rivals and returns as a cat ghost to seek revenge

Title: 761. The Tour of the Grand Dukes
description: Gaston Fromageot, the son of the lawyer Fromageot is in love with Brigitte , the daughter of the baroness.This night , the priest, the lawyer and Gaston have arrived at the house of the baroness who asks them why they have comer so late in the night, the lawyer then speaks about the restoration of the bell tower.They show her a document, she needs her glasses and sends Gaston who goes to the room of Brigitte asking her for a kiss.After giving a kiss, Brigitte decides to discourage Gaston speaking about her lover , a crooner who lives in Paris.Gaston returns to the living room and proposes the baroness to help her to have a fund-raising gala for the restoration of the bell tower: the baroness lends him 300.000 francs for the contracts of the singing artists who will take part in the gala.

Title: 762. Hujan panas
description: Narrating Amir (P. Ramlee), is a restaurant waiter who aspires to be a songwriter. He has a crush on Aminah (Siput Sarawak), a singer at his workplace.

Title: 764. Elizabeth Is Queen
description: This spectacular 1953 documentary, released in cinemas, records the events of Elizabeth II's coronation day in glorious colour. From British Pathé TV's Royalty Collection.

Title: 766. Rimskiy-Korsakov
description: A musical biography of the great Russian classical composer.

Title: 768. Skid Kids
description: Swanky Clarke (Barry MacGregor) and his gang of chums take on a gang of bike thieves with the help of the local police.

Title: 770. Nissae bila regal
description: Gamal and his wife Dawlat move into his strict aunt Afet's household, where women must live without men. The women challenge oppressive rules, seeking love, freedom, and personal choice.

Title: 771. What Is Your Name? Part II
772. Así es Madrid
description: Dramas and successes in the lives of the inhabitants of a building in old Madrid.

Title: 773. Jirocho Strikes a Daring Blow
description: Jirocho and his followers chase the Kurokomas into the Kai Province.

Title: 774. Green Magic
description: A group of Italians explore the jungles of South America.

Title: 776. No te ofendas, Beatriz
description: Beatrice has Javier, her dad-approved boyfriend Javier (Abel Salazar) as cover-up to please her jealous father Don Ramon (Domingo Soler), but meets regularly with Mario (Manolo Fábregas) helped by Javier who enjoys the perks that his future father in law gives him. As the plot advances, after many funny situations, all of them get to discover their true feelings.

Title: 778. ¡Che, qué loco!
description: A ruined Pepe Valdés (Pepe Iglesias) tries to marry the millionaire Esperancita (Emma Penella), which triggers a series of misunderstandings.

Title: 779. Ivan, Son of the White Devil
780. All jordens fröjd
description: The young girl Lisbet lives on the farm Tolfmansgården together with her mother, her older brother Jerker and their grandparents.

Title: 781. Golnesa
description: Golnesa is the popular girl of their village and all want to marry her, but she is deceived by a man from the city.

Title: 782. Kele Handa
description: The plot of "Kele Handa" is a love story of Malani, a village girl who goes to town to see the Vel festival and falls in love with John Jayapala, a rich young gentleman who pretends himself to her as a commoner. The story of well-born, bred, and wealthy John Jayapala is the folly of falling in love with a poor but beautiful village girl, depicting the inevitable class struggle. The village people are rubber tree collectors and are prosperous during the festival time and after become poverty again. A very young John Jayapala, an idealist, pursued, wooed, and wins the love of Malani. Ada Jayapala, John Jayapala's mother never forgives the heir to the Jayapala inheritance. She never let go of her ambitions for her son who was well-educated both locally and abroad. At this time there is much nationalism displayed in the country hitherto governed by the British and the rumbles of independence were forming. The country is poised for a great future and the proud matriarch had great political ambitions for her son. Malani learns the life of the city, in a mansion alone with only Mrs. Daniel who was her English lessons and music tutor, while her young husband is abroad. Malani falls on the floor and bows at Ada Jayapala's feet and begs her not to separate John from her love and life. But there is no sympathy in Ada's heart. So, Ada Jayapala, her society, and the family environment do not allow the love to grow or to end in marriage. Later, John Jayapala marries an upper-class girl named Daisy Attanayake and Malani finds out that and gives up hope on John Jayapala and goes to India to learn dance. Later she returns to Sri Lanka as renowned Vishnu Bhai, an Indian celebrity dancer. After seeing her performance in a theater, John Jayapala realizes that this is the Malani he had loved and his going for her creates complications for the Jayapala family's honor, especially John's pregnant wife. Ada Jayapala falls on the floor and bows at Malani's feet and begs her not to separate John from Jayapala family and from John's pregnant wife. Malani's heart feels sorry for John's wife's crucial situation. In the end, Malani inherits everything else but does not win in her love. She suffers a great loss spiritually. In the end, she jumps into the river and commits a painful death, marking the end of her love story with a tragic end. The novel ends with Daisy, impressed by her sacrifice, creating a monument for her.

Title: 786. Esos de Pénjamo
description: Un ranchero se casa con su prima para que sus herederos puedan quedarse con sus propiedades cuando muera desgraciadamente, no le es posible tener hijos, y esto lo aprovechará su cuñada, cuyo hijo se convertirá en la descendencia que siempre ha deseado.

Title: 787. Below the Sahara
description: The photographic record of an African expedition led by producer-explorer Armand Denis and his (very) photogenic and camera-toting wife Michaela, who goes bird-riding at an ostrich farm. The expedition ranges from the central interior jungles and mountains to both coasts and as far south as Cape Town, and ends with a gorilla hunt led by natives using 100-year-old muskets. Denis produced and directed with the entire production under the supervision of Jay Bonafield and Douglas Travers, with commentary written by Jerome Brondfield and Burton Benjamin and camerawork credited to Tom Stobart, Phil Scultz, Robert Carmet and Eric White.

Title: 788. Wheel of Fate
description: Two brothers work in their invalid father's repair garage. Johnny is the quiet, reliable one while Ted is younger and wilder. The brothers feud over Lucky, a beautiful band singer. Then their life is complicated: first by a police search for the unknown killer of a man in a dance hall fight, and then by a bookie pressuring Ted to pay his gambling debts.

Title: 790. A Dupla do Barulho
description: The mishaps of a couple of itinerant artists, Tonico and Tião, who go around Brazil searching for fame and fortune. The duo's trip is marred by difficult and funny situations, especially when Tião starts to feel neglected by his partner.

Title: 791. El diablo toca la flauta
description: When the pieces of a singular figure are unearthed and then joined together, a devil of the lowest category breaks into a small Mediterranean village. From that moment on, the demon will enter the life of a painter named Bernardino, in the affairs of a "modern" marriage, in the existence of a frightened gardener and, finally, in the day-to-day life of the Great Momo.

Title: 792. Ave Maria
description: Karin Twerdy used to be an opera singer but now, in order to pay for her daughter Daniela's education in a religious school, she performs in a shady nightclub. Industrialist Dietrich Gontard, the father of Karin's school friend Christa, falls for her. But when he learns the truth about her he is outraged and rejects her. At a loss and not to stand in the way of Daniela's future, Karin chooses to disappear...

Title: 793. Mask in Blue
description: In a vehicle for energetic musical star Marika Rokk, she is unwilling to pose as an artist's model, until an act of male deception is contrived. There is a dance number involving a lady cursed to wear a mask, until love redeems her.

Title: 795. Moselfahrt aus Liebeskummer
description: Thomas offers Dorette a trip to Moselle that she rejects saying it's short notice, but when Thomas shows at her apartment the next day he finds she's not slept on her bed. He leaves for Dorette alone, and there he meets Angela.

Title: 797. Ella, Lucifer y yo
description: A man makes a pact with Lucifer in order to gain the love of a beautiful singer. To achieve his goal, the devil endows him with the ability to become invisible at will.

Title: 798. Saariston tyttö
description: A mysterious visitor arrives to a sleepy island and falls in love with a local girl who is practically engaged to a local boy.

Title: 800. Mahallenin Namusu
description: What happened to a woman trying to protect her honor.

Title: 804. Onna hitori daichi o yuku
description: Uses the lifespan of a young girl working in the coal mines to illustrate the history of Japan from the period leading up to WWII to the war's aftermath.

Title: 806. María Dolores
description: In Algeciras, in the Southern coast of Spain near Tangier, an Andalusian café covers a cocaine traffic business that both the Spanish and Moroccan Police try to dismantle.

Title: 807. Clipped Wings
description: Slip and Sach mistakenly enlist in the Air Force where Sach is mistakenly assigned to the WACs.

Title: 809. Uncle Willie's Bicycle Shop
description: In England, alcoholic Uncle Willie vexes his family. They let him buy a bike shop to woo American heiress Virginia, who loves Willie's nephew Frank.

Title: 810. Dios los cría
description: House invader Tin-Tan poses as a butler to protect wacky millionaire Nini Marshall from scammers.

Title: 811. Mickey's Birthday Party
description: Disney celebrates Mickey Mouse's 25th Anniversary with a feature-length compilation of six of his all-time fan favorite cartoons.

Title: 812. Maternité clandestine
description: A pack of bad boys,under a gangster's thumb,saves a pregnant young girl who tries to commit suicide.

Title: 814. Koenigsmark
description: A young French,Vignerte, is hired in the court of Lautenberg ,an imaginary land,as the young Prince's private teacher and as the Grand Duchess' reader.

Title: 815. Hurra - ein Junge!
description: The honest Professor Weber sees his happy family life at risk when a young man appears.

Title: 820. The Steel Key
description: An adventurer investigates the theft of a formula for hardened steel, assisted by his girlfriend.

Title: 821. Mustasukkaisuus
description: The siblings Riitta and Anja love the same man, the treasurer Jyri Mara. Riitta ends up marrying Jyri, but when the couple loses their children Riitta gets jealous and mad.

Title: 822. Misericordia
description: Faded rich family has a housekeeper who struggles to keep them fed and comfortable after their fortune disappears; she also sacrifices herself on behalf of sick and disabled friends.

Title: 823. Soygun
description: The bandit Ismail, who started a new life in Istanbul, will be involved in crime in his new jobs too.

Title: 824. Top of the Form
description: Some trouble with gambling forces con man Fortescue to hide out in a boys' school, posing as a professor. When the undisciplined and lazy boys have to pass a few tests, cheating becomes the only option.

Title: 825. The Good Beginning
description: A struggling pen-pusher and his wife envy the casual, live-now-pay-later lifestyle of their irresponsible friends.

Title: 826. The History of Flight: We Saw It Happen
description: This documentary, chronicles the first 50 years of flight, from the Wright Brothers first flight in 1903 to 1953. It includes interviews with an original mechanic who worked in their bicycle shop and a wide range of other pioneers such as Frank Long, Igor Sikorsky, Glen Martin, Alan Lockheed, Eddie Rickenbacker, Jimmy Doolittle, LeRoy Grumman, Robert Gross Connie and Wellwood Beel.

Title: 827. Le père de Mademoiselle
description: The father of the girl is a magistrate with a high sense of duty.The daughter, Françoise is a romantic girl.The mother of the girl is an ambitious woman who doesn't accept the second place of her husband in a town of province.Françoise escapes from her family because she didn't agree with an arranged matrimony and goes to Paris where she becomes the secretary of Edith Mars, a great comedian.In a letter to her sister she wrote that she was working in an American company and gave the address of Edith as her address.Now the parents are arriving from Nancy to Paris.

Title: 829. Quiero vivir
description: Man in the final stages of a fatal illness gets immersed in a new romance and a murder investigation.

Title: 833. Maldición gitana
description: Alejo is a widowed violinist whose mother-in-law, Mss Encarna, keeps threatening him by sending him telegrams every month. When he remarries, his new mother-in-law makes his life impossible. One day, the Mss Encarna ghost appears to him.

Title: 835. Il prezzo dell'onore
description: After a few years spent as an immigrant in Belgium, Antonio is back in his village in the South of Italy. He dreams of leaving again, for Argentina this time, but his sister Maria and his father persuade him into staying. Maria is engaged to Francesco, the chief woodcutter working for Don Nicola, the richest man in the area. When the latter fires Francesco, he offers the position to Antonio, who accepts. As for Don Nicola, he becomes infatuated with Maria who, although she spurns his advances, becomes the victim of the villagers' talk, which causes her fiancé to run afoul of her. Maria decides to leave the village and finds a job in the nearest town.

Title: 837. Ni pobres ni ricos
description: A rich spoiled heir gets rid of all her possessions to gain the love of a poor and proud hard working man.

Title: 842. Sa isang sulyap mo Tita
description: "Sa isang sulyap mo Tita" dubbed as one of the biggest and spectacular musical movies in the 50s and starring the country's popular reel-and real life sweetheart and husband-and-wife tandem in Philippine movie, Pancho Magalona and Tita Duran. With the backdrop and setting in the life in the navy. It looks of two Hollwood musical classics - "Anchors Aweigh" (1945) and "On the Town" (1949). Pancho Magalona and Dolphy as navy men or sailors, ala-Frank Sinatra and Gene Kelly, are in days of and they're out to have lots of fun, singing, dancing and drinking. As they say, They're out to "paint the town red". Dolphy, probably his first major movie role as Pancho's buddy exhibits his awesome dancing skills.

Title: 844. Chacha Chowdhury
description: Two look-a-likes, a mental asylum inmate and a rich businessman, land at places meant for each other.

Title: 846. Nachala hanem
description: A girl learns the craft of pick pocketing, she joins one of the gangs that exploits her. The gang boss asks her to steal a precious jewel owned by a wealthy man, and she pretends to be his niece.

Title: 847. Dum-Bom
description: The mayor of Bomsta, the efficient but insensitive Fabian Bom, has remade his town into a social-engineer's dream. The only inefficient thing left is the old farm Rosengård. The farm has recently been inherited by Camilla, a childhood friend of Fabian Bom. Bomsta is visited by a circus where Fabian Bom's long lost twin brother, Dumbom, is the clown. Unlike his brother, Dumbom only cares about life and beauty.

Title: 848. Katil
description: Kemal escapes from prison to prove his innocence and want to find his wife (Nevin) because can not receives any news from her.

Title: 849. Heaven Is Ours
description: A girl without a family commits petty thefts in order to support her grandmother. One day, she meets an officer of the Air Force who decides to take care of them.

Title: 850. Staatsanwältin Corda
description: The talented law student Corda has a severe traffic accident: in panic she fled after an argument with her older boyfriend, who told her he's married. Now, 8 years later without having seen him, she's the first woman in town to become district attorney. However in her first case she's to sue against landlord Neidard, who looks exactly like her old flame. Old memories are awakened, and make her neglect her professional duties.

Title: 851. The A-B-C's of Love
description: Filmed version of a burlesque performance, featuring strippers, songs and comedy routines.

Title: 852. Bila sam jaca
description: Instead of running away from enemy raid, a female partisan-doctor decides to stay and help one of their wounded children.

Title: 856. Zafer günesi
description: It is the story of an officer who was blinded during the War of Independence and began to see after marrying the girl he loves, Leyla.

Title: 865. Acorralada
description: A female singer who killed her husband in Cuba takes refuge in Argentina and is chased by a police officer.

Title: 870. Cinci Hoca
description: A story that tells the events surrounding an Ottoman sultan in the 17th century.

Title: 872. Papi
description: On the run from the police, an atheist masquerades as a religious icon.

Title: 874. Dansa, min docka...
description: In the small town Skrabbarp lives the school teacher Sebastian Pettersson, an amateur detective and one of the most diligent correspondents of the Stockholm police.

Title: 876. Bou Thakuranir Hath
description: Based on true story of Raja Pratapaditya Roy of Jessore.

Title: 877. Die Privatsekretärin
description: Determined Gerda Weber travels to the big city and locates at a girl's pension. She soon finds job as a secretary in a big business thanks to her optimism and wits, and ends dating her boss after mistaking him for a companion. They share an evening of music and dancing, after which she discovers who he really is.

Title: 878. Lisanak husanak
description: In this 105-minute marathon of uninterrupted buffoonery, the village mayor sends his son to Cairo along with al-Dandrawy to meet with Hamdy [Karem Mahmoud], who is working at the Tram Company so a school and a hospital can be built in the village. There is an emotional relationship between Hamdy and his neighbor Hamida [Shadia]. Hamida's Aunt Wedad [Zeinat Sedki] likes the musician Ghandour [Farid Shawqi], who has hired Hamida to sing in his group. Ghandour wants to marry Wedad, but she refuses him. Maria [Hind Rostom] likes Ghandour. The singing group goes to the mayor's village and Ghandour and Mandour [Aziz Osman] decide to steal a large amount of money so they can blame it on Hamdy, but their plan fails. Everyone knows Ghandour and Mandour are behind the theft. Hamdy marries Hamida and her Aunt Wedad marries the village mayor. Hind Rostom (1931-2011) appears here at the age of 22 in a prominent role as Maria, a singing and dancing brunette.

Title: 879. Le gang des pianos à bretelles
880. El plebeyo
description: The story of a wealthy family that owns mines, and the series of problems they must face.

Title: 882. Des quintuplés au pensionnat
description: In a girls boarding-school run by Madame Piégeois, young Gisèle meets at night the count of Champrès's son.

Title: 884. Südliche Nächte
description: The fortune-hunters Harry and Thomas set out for Italy to look for singer Gina, whom they met during the war. They find her with a small music troupe. Harry is so convinced of her skills that he finances a new revue for her.

Title: 885. Les détectives du dimanche
description: Two state employees ,Molot and Maurent ,are very fond of detective stories.They open a private eyes agency,which opens only on Sunday.But the clients are rare,and some kind of Arsène Lupin steals their savings.They set out to track so called suspects down but everything backfires on them;however,one fine day ,a man knocks on their door: he asks them to shadow his fiancee who may(or may not) be true to him.Maurent falls for her.

Title: 890. Kanna Talli
description: Kanna Thalli is a 1972 Indian Telugu film, directed by Dasari Narayana Rao and produced by K.V.Mahadevan. The film stars Shoban Babu, Savitri and Chandrakala in lead roles. The film had musical score by Saketh Sairam.

Title: 892. Now and Forever
description: The True-to Life Story of the Kuusela-Hilatio Romance.

Title: 893. Un trésor de femme
description: François goes to the jewellers to get a ring for his fiancée Isabelle. However a strange Sophie tries the ring on and it gets stuck. François has to follow her around in order to try and get the ring back and the two think they have fallen in love. However, both eventually return to their existing partners.

Title: 905. Martyn Borulya
description: The protagonist of the film - tenant Martin Borulya decided to become a nobleman because of a quarrel with Mr. Krasovsky.

Title: 906. Vergiß die Liebe nicht
description: A tenor sparks new hope into the life of a wife,a former piano player whose husband has not been paying enough attention to her.

Title: 907. Esquina da Ilusão
description: An Italian immigrant, owner of a small cantina in Brás, São Paulo, with the visit of his brother who had prospered in Italy, pretends to be a big industrialist with a common surname.

Title: 908. Glasberget
description: The successful glass artist Stellan Sylvester ends up in the hospital after a car accident. He looks back at his life and finds it empty and meaningless. He falls in love with the nurse Marta but when he finds out that she engaged life turns out to be even more meaningless.

Title: 910. Tangier Incident
description: Steve Gordon, an American agent posing as a black market operator, is in Tangier on a mission to stop the plans of three atomic scientists who are there to pool their secrets and sell them in a package to the Communists.

Title: 912. En skärgårdsnatt
description: Different groups of people gather on an island in Stockholm's archipelago for a night of fun.

Title: 916. Let's Be Good Citizens at Play
917. Shyama
description: Viswanathan, a famous director, is haunted by the death of his wife and a young man whom he accidentally hit while driving. Later he meets Shyama, the daughter of his friend, still struggling with the death of her boyfriend, the man whom Viswanathan had killed. They fall in love but Viswanatan tries to avoid her. In the climax, he reveals the truth to shyama. He tries to leave the town but is stopped by her brother chandran. They have a fight and Viswanathan is hurt.
Two men, one English and one Afrikaans, apply for bus tickets with the intention of going on a trip and they spend their time not relaxing, but getting in each other's faces.

Title: 928. Maldita
description: Pancho, Boy and Rita these three together in laughs and action spell - D-Y-N-A-M-I-T-E.

Title: 934. 10 anni della nostra vita
description: Over 10 years of Italian history, drawn together from newsreels.

Title: 936. Dangerous Youth
description: Egon, a young man from Jutland living with relatives in Copenhagen, meets sensible young girl Ruth and falls in love. But Egon is involved with a gang of criminals, and when they assault a man they meet in a bar they are caught by the police. Egon is sent to a juvenile home, but can he stay out of trouble?

Title: 937. La mujer desnuda
description: A woman is married to a famous singer and is blackmailed by an old flame who forces her to dance in a cabaret.

Title: 938. Geraldine
description: Janey Edwards, working for Cambria Records, is managing the personal appearance tour of sobbing songster Billy Weber, and she is disgusted after Billy leaves her at Santa Fe College with orders to get the rights, by hook or crook, to a folk song they had heard sung by Grant Sanborn , music instructor at the school. Posing as a co-ed, Janey gets Grant to give her a recording of the folk song which he has made, and then takes it to her boss, Jason Ambrose, in New York. Ambrose is unimpressed by the song, but is sold on Grant's voice and he assumes that Grant has been put under contract. Janey returns to the college to get Grant to sign a contract but not telling him that Cambria Records only wants him to record popular songs and is not interested in his folk music. Along with dummy recordings of his folk songs, Janey gets Grant to record one new song, "Geraldine", which immediately becomes a big hit. Janey refuses to bring Grant back to New York to make more records because the company hasn't marketed his folk music, as promised. Ambrose tells her the folk music album has just been ordered into release and, feeling now that Grant will get a fair deal, Janey returns to Santa Fe with the album. What she does not know is the album has been faked by Ambrose, and one of the records, included by mistake, is that of Billy Weber singing the folk song stolen from Grant.

Title: 939. Fael Khair
description: Khayri Madbouly, a poor but talented singer, falls in love with the wealthy Soheir. Her father rejects the match, so Khayri sets out to achieve fame and fortune.

Title: 940. Target Hong Kong
description: American soldiers of fortune smash a spy plot aimed at seizing Hong Kong.

Title: 941. Tit Coq
description: After returning home from war, an ill-tempered young soldier must deal with his sweetheart having married another man.

Title: 942. A Perilous Journey
description: Francie Landereaux is one of 29 women on a voyage to California on a barter-bride deal in which any qualified man can buy a wife. Unknown to the sponsors, she is already married to a man who has deserted her and she is on the voyage to find him. The husband is a wanted man and Shard Benton captures him in Panama for the reward. When the ship reaches California, Francine takes a job with Monty Breed, an old enemy of Benton. The husband returns and is killed by Breed. Benton and Breed gamble with Francine at stake.

Title: 943. Ai margini della metropoli
description: In Rome a young man is falsely accused of killing his girlfriend.

Title: 944. Safari Drums
description: A bunch of movie makers arrive in Africa to make a film about jungle wildlife. A geologist gets killed. Bomba the Jungle Boy investigates and solves the murder. He assists crew in completing their movie.

Title: 945. A Família Lero-Lero
description: Aquiles Taveira is a civil servant harassed by his own family's financial demands. Tired of it, he decides to fake an embezzlement at his work and runs away to the seaside resort of Guarujá, where he manages to live peacefully, for too short a time.

Title: 946. The Dog and the Diamonds
description: A group of petless children secretly build a zoo behind an old manor, unaware it hides jewel thieves. The children find the crooks, then join forces with their animals to defeat them.

Title: 947. The Epopee of Warsaw
description: Biopic about General Karol Swierczewski, living embodiment of the party line, and the group of party members from his hometown fighting the fascist forces towards the socialist state of affairs.

Title: 948. Keine Angst vor großen Tieren
description: Emil is a coward. When he falls in love with a woman who wants a real man, he has to find the courage beyond his jolly demeanor.

Title: 949. Había una vez un marido
description: Rather unusual and unexpected wedding anniversary gifts, such as a pair of women's panties with the name "Teresa" on them get a husband in hot water with his wife, and need some explaining during this 93 minute Musical-Comedy.

Title: 950. The Devil's Money
description: Manuel, a factory worker, and Estrella, a rumba dancer, conspire to rob Manuel's employer.

Title: 951. On Top of Old Smoky
description: Poachers are harassing toll road owner Jen Larrabee. They want her land because it holds valuable minerals. Autry and the Cass County Boys, mistaken for Texas Rangers, help out.

Title: 952. Hamido
description: Hamido (Farid Shawky) is a fisherman who works as a hand for hire on a fishing boat in the Abu Qir area in Alexandria, and lives with his mother (Firdous Muhammad). He is in a relationship of affection and love with the gypsy Saadia (Huda Sultan), who reads the fortune, to support her blind father (Abdul Majid Shukri) and her little brother Samaka (Suleiman Al-Gundi), who works as a sea boy for Hamido, Hamido was looking forward to have a boat of his own so that he does not work as a wage-earner for others. And get that fast he started smuggling opium by sea, by the help of his hinge man Sharshoura (Said Abu Bakr). They used to get drugs from other ships crossing the Mediterranean, and keep them in the sea water until they pass the Coast Guard inspection of fishermen, then sneak into the sea at night, and recover the drugs. Sharshoura became addicted to the opium, until he lost his ability to work after his health worsened, and so Hamido started working alone one night while Hamido was recovering drugs from the water, one of the patrols surprised him, and he found Saadia, so he handed her the drug packet as it contained On the roe, and asked her to hand it over to him the next day, thus he escaped from the night patrol, and on the next day he was surprised that Saadia knew the contents of the box, and she advised him to stop that way. Under the claims of love and the promise of marriage, Saadia surrendered to Hamido until she became pregnant from him. And when he refused to marry her, she informed his mother of her pregnancy from him. Hamido decided to get rid of Saadia, so he lured her to the sea and drowned her in it, but a fisherman saw her in the water and rescued her. While all that happened he was under surveillance by the drug investigations, with reporting news of the drug trade to the police, who decided to attack Hamido's gang, but Hamido was able to mislead the police and escape from them, and he resorted to the sea, where he found the boat that rescued Saadia , and he fled to the sea and started exchanged fire with the coast guard ship, but he was surprised that Saadia was alive on the back of the boat, with a hand gun was aimed at him, and when he snatched it from her and tried to kill her, the Coast Guard rushed and killed him.

Title: 953. Velikoye proshchaniye
description: March 9th, 1953. A gray, sad day. Clouds float low over the Kremlin towers. A city that unrecognizably grew, prettier and matured - this Moscow froze in solemn grief. The country escorts its father and leader, Joseph Stalin.

Title: 954. Natsuko's Adventure in Hokkaido
description: Born to a prestigious family, Natsuko is not impressed by any one of her suitors. Determined to spend her life serving god, she sets off to a convent in Hokkaido and meets a young bear-hunter with whom she begins an adventure.

Title: 955. Easter Parade
description: One in a series of 15 "Walt Disney Cartoon Packages" keyed to various seasons. Each package consists of six cartoons with a total running time of approximately 45 minutes. Each group, combined as a feature presentation with a main title, is supported with accessories, including trailer, one-sheets, ad mats, and press books. The complete list includes "New Year's Jamboree", "Winter Hilarities", "Spring Frolics", "Drive-In Frivolities", "Drive-In Capers", "April Fool's Frolics", "Easter Parade", "Summer Jubilee", "Fourth Of July Firecrackers", "Fall Varieties", "Hallowe'en Hilarities", "Election Day Gaieties", "Thanksgiving Day Mirthquakes", and "Christmas Jollities."

Title: 956. Old Overland Trail
description: Indian agent Rex Allen must protect local citizens and a tribe of volatile Native Americans from unscrupulous railroad contractors--including his own brother.

Title: 958. Las infieles
description: A circle of women whose friendship includes confiding their unfaithfulness. The story revolves around the return of a former lover they share in common and the struggle by the main character to remain faithful.

Title: 959. The Loving Women
description: When three beautiful young nurses from Jalisco, afflicted with a rare disease called "sexappealitis", create commotion among the patients in a hospital and they are forced to resign, they travel to Mexico City following the suggestion of a crazy scientist, who tells them they will be cured when they get married, but they are attracted to three men who are indifferent to their sexy looks, being themselves sick with "lovetitis".

Title: 960. Il tesoro del Bengala
description: A fun fantasy classic for the entire family. In this exotic adventure, young hero Sabu is living in a remote Hindu village. There he must protect the town treasure, the world's largest ruby, from being stolen.

Title: 962. El vagabundo
description: A hobo doesn't let abject poverty affect his generosity and noble heart, but he gets into a lot of trouble and ends up in the zoo park of a circus.

Title: 964. Canadian Mounties vs. Atomic Invaders
description: A villain named Marlof attempts to set up secret missile bases inside Canada so he can launch missiles at the U.S. The Canadian Mounted Police dispatch agents to try to stop him.

Title: 966. Three's Company
description: Compilation of 3 episodes of the TV series "Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. Presents ..." (i)"The Surgeon" (ii)"Take A Number" (iii)"The Scream".

Title: 967. L'uomo, la bestia e la virtù
description: Paolino, a teacher at an elementary school near Naples, appears nervous for a few days and his friends do not know why. The man is the lover of Assunta, the mother of one of his pupils, and he discovers that she has become pregnant.

Title: 968. Me tulemme taas
description: About four raftsmen seeking romance with a widow and her two attractive daughters.

Title: 969. L'appel du destin
description: Young conductor Roberto Lombardini has never known his father who is actually a former musician, a failed piano player who has sunk into alcoholism.

Title: 970. Daleko je sunce
description: Down under the constant attacks of the German and Bulgarian forces, headquarters one of the partisan detachment in the midst of a severe winter and snow and difficult terrain, with many wounded, he decided to leave the mountain Jastrebac. Gvozden, a peasant from that area, brave warrior, opposes such a decision, was gets ready to leave the unit before detachment. In the interests of discipline, however, Gvozden was convicted and executed on the spot, although it regrets the whole squad.

Title: 971. Kiskrajcár
description: A young woman goes to work on the construction site for the future Stalin City.

Title: 973. Candinho
description: Candinho is a hillbilly who leaves the country, taking his donkey along, and goes to São Paulo, trying to find his mother.

Title: 974. Down Laredo Way
description: Rodeo star Rex Allen investigates the death of a colleague and in the process uncovers a ring of diamond smugglers.

Title: 975. L'incantevole nemica
description: The owner of a cheese factory fears communists and mistakes a meek youth who works for him for one of them. He invites him to his house to win his confidence and the youth falls in love with his daughter.

Title: 976. Saluti e baci
description: Carlo Mastelli, the young radio presenter of "New Voices" has run short of ideas and his program is likely to be suspended from the radio schedule if he does not find any new ones. He is saved by chance in the person of Marina, a charming young school teacher, who takes advantage of the presence of a radio crew in her village for the recording of a singing contest to broadcast an appeal in favor of Tonino, the most underprivileged of her pupils. She asks the listeners to send postcards from any place in the world to cheer up little Tonino. The response is enthusiastic and tons of mail land in the radio studios, at the same time boosting the audience of Calo's moribund program. Eventually, despite some trouble with a rare stamp, all ends well and Carlo marries Marina.

Title: 977. Return of the Plainsman
description: The first of two commercially successful collaborations between Rafferty and Robinson is an Australian western in which Rafferty plays a legendary bushman known as the Sundowner who, with his Aboriginal offsider, tracks down a gang of cattle rustlers.

Title: 979. Gilbert Harding Speaking of Murder
description: A compilation of 3 stories, (i)"The Missing Passenger" (ii) "Falstaff's Fur Coat" (iii) "Thirty Days To Die". Originally part of the Danziger Brothers' UK series made in 1953 as "Mayfair Mystery House" and hosted by an unidentified 'Mr. X', The series was reformatted as "Calling Scotland Yard" hosted by Paul Douglas and sold to Paramount for theatrical release in 1954, At least six of these films were shown in theaters before all the episodes were acquired by NBC and screened as "Adventure Theatre" in 1956.

Title: 980. The Janissary
description: During the turbulent and dangerous years of the Turkish Occupation of Greece, the oppressive Ottomans systematically abducted Christian boys, to raise and educate them according to the strict Muhammadan standards.

Title: 982. Gulacha Ganapati
description: This is the story of a simple, happy go lucky, poor but with a heart of gold man named "Narya" (Shri P.L.Deshpande) who lives in a chawl and works at a local grocery stores. His loyal and honest nature often lands him in trouble because of which his strict and kind heart master always thrash him. Narya is deeply in love with a noble and beautiful girl named "Leela" (Chitra) who stays in the same chawl as that of Narya along with her retired politician and ailing father. Leela is the only bread earner of her family and sells flowers outside temples to manage daily expenses. Narya always comes ahead to help her without expecting anything in return which develops a great friendship and bonding between the two. Narya is also a gifted method actor who often goes deep into the skin of famous historical character the moment he sees the respective poster or the photo. On one fine day Narya sees the poster of the great maratha king Chatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj and starts enacting and delivering dialogues like him which catches attention of a Theater group owner who quickly hires him for the titular role of "Shri Sambhuji Maharaj" for his upcoming play. The owner pays him the sum of Rs.15/- as an advance from Rs.100/- of his total pay. Narya uses this amount to pay of the rent of Leela's room by comically thrashing away the owner of her room. Leela after seeing his selfless nature falls in love with him. On the eve of the stage performance Narya becomes nervous and runs away from the theater after seeing his master sitting in the audience. Blaming himself for his coward deed, Narya starts delivering his dialogue of his character "Shri Sambhuji Maharaj" in the middle of the jungle that catches attention of a "soon to be formed" political group. Seeing the enigma and performance of Narya the supremo "Sudarshan" (Vinay Kale) decides to use "Sambhuji's" character for the publicity of his political party. Sudarshan makes the dirty use of Narya to create a public figure of Shri Sambhuji Maharaj. Shri Sambhuji Maharah is introduced in the media and local issues and made to attend various public seminars and appearances. His idealistic, native and down to the earth charm finds immediate appeal with the citizens. This draws the gullible public to his frequent public addresses and soon Sambhuji Maharaj becomes a cult figure. Meanwhile Sudarshan and his mates earn a lot of wealth out of this and this is the time when he starts showing his true colours. He starts ill treating Narya by not giving him his monthly salary, rest and even food because of which Narya falls unconscious during a public rally. He starts missing his old life and thus writes a letter to Leela . Leela soon reaches Narya and finds out the entire scam. She fools Sudarshan about falling in love with him and wishes her plan about marrying him. She makes him gullible the same way how he did it with Narya and eventually puts him behind the bars. Sudarshan and his mates are sentenced to imprisonment for 3 years while Narya is set free. Narya and Leela get married while Narya's master decides to take care of the newly wed couple.

Title: 983. Milyon Genaih
description: Zumurrud Agha leaves an inheritance estimated at one million pounds, and the heirs are Mukhtar, Marzooq, Lady Aishah, and Wafa. However, in order to obtain the inheritance, it is required that the person closest to him be the guardian of the rest of heirs, and this person is Falafel the beggar, who is found and informed about the inheritance and that she is the guardian of the rest of heirs. Falafel must act and learn the immoral intentions of the rest of heirs, which they intend to achieve after receiving the money, and the relationship develops between her and Husni, whom she loved.

Title: 984. Serebristaya pyl
description: An American scientist invents a new weapon of mass destruction - silver dust. Corporate war breaks out between two military industry giants to own the weapon. The scientist dies and his son makes the discovery public with more consequences.

Title: 987. Goldtown Ghost Riders
description: Circuit judge Gene must judge a man who claims he's already done time for the killing he's accused of.

Title: 988. Baeat el-Khubz
description: The husband dies and leaves his wife Khadijah and their two children Nimat and Sami who go to live with a relative of them. After getting arrested on charge of burning the factory where her husband was working (a crime managed by Boss Abdulhakim after Khadijah refused to marry him), she becomes insane and gets hospitalized. After ten years, her memories return after a fire in hospital. She begins a journey to search for Nimat and Sami. Nimat was raised in an orphanage, and she now loves Midhat. Sami becomes a lawyer. Khadijah starts working as a bread vendor in a furnace in the name of Hamidah. Abdulhakim hides under the name of Gharib, marries, and has a sick daughter. Nimat gets to know Gharib's daughter, but Gharib tells his daughter that Nimat's mother burned the factory. Gharib tries to kill Khadijah, but she recognizes that he is Boss Abdulhakim. He admits her innocence as his daughter dies.

Title: 989. Valley of Song
description: Rivalry among members of the male voice choir!

Title: 990. Café chantant
description: Sor Clemente escapes the surveillance of his wife and goes to attend a variety show.

Title: 991. Adam and Eve
description: Early romantic and mildly erotic comedy by Danish star director Erik Balling who earned his first Bodil awards from this 1953 movie. It's all about an anonymous little gray book originating from sexually advanced Paris. The book doesn't look like much, but shouldn't be judged by its cover. Wherever this book goes, something will happen. And for sure, this book goes around.

Title: 992. Mole Alley
description: 33-year-old poor writer Ogata was able to endure his miserable life cheerfully thanks to Yoshie, a 19-year-old innocent young wife. After graduating from a girls' school in Hokuriku, she immediately moved to Tokyo to meet and marry Ogata. After neatly writing Ogata's manuscript, he would buy dorayaki as a gratuity and devour it.

Title: 993. Kaiserwalzer
description: During his summer holidays, archduke Ludwig falls in love with the beautiful teacher Luise Pichler. A hopeless love, because his sister-in-law, empress Elisabeth, has other plans for him.

Title: 994. Das war unser Rommel
description: Documentary about the German campaign in Africa in 1941/42 and the personality of Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

Title: 997. Sueños de gloria
description: Elsa is a spoiled girl, daughter of the owner of an auto parts factory. Luis is a mechanic who yearns to be able to undertake a project. By chance both will meet, but they won't have a good first impression of each other: when she, after treating him with disdain, owed him 50 pesos for his services and sends him with his father to pay him. When he has the opportunity to meet the entrepreneur, Luis gets his support to carry out a project for his car workshop, however, he'll face the company's engineer, who won't only seek to take away the intellectual property of his invention but is also Elsa's boyfriend. In the middle of the intrigues, the protagonist manages to enter the automotive Panamerican race, while Elsa learns the value of effort.

Title: 999. Brudebuketten
description: Siv Blom sleepwalks. She starts working for a company, where the younger boss soon falls in love with her. She starts going to therapy. However, that visit makes things even worse: Siv begins to walk backwards in a trance down Karl Johan.
